recipes.title: 5-Cup Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges very well on paper towels. Mix all ingredients together. Make 24 hours ahead or early in the morning.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Mexican Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and seasoning mix. Spread on bottom of 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish. Layer remaining ingredients over cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Almond Bacon Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10¾ oz.) can condensed cream of onion or cream
directions: In a microwave, cook bacon on paper towels on high for 1 – 3 minutes or until partially cooked. Wrap 2 bacon strips around each chicken breast. Sprinkle with pepper. Arrange in an 8-inch square, microwave safe dish. Cover and microwave on high for 7 minutes. Drain.

In a bowl, combine soup & broth. Cover and microwave for 2 minutes. Spoon around chicken. Cook, uncovered 5 – 7 minutes longer or until juices run clear. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with almonds.

recipes.title: Aloha Dip
ingredients: ¼ cup firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Mix together macaroons, sugar, and sour cream. Chill several hours to soften macaroon crumbs. Do not stir again or crumbs will be too small. Fill pineapple shell with mixture. Serve with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Appetizer Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lg. can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Mix pineapple and sauce together. Add frozen meatballs. Put in slow cooker on high for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda 1 cup vegetable oil
3 cups chopped apples 1 cup butterscotch chips
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and set aside. Mix (by hand) sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla until blended. Add flour mixture until blended. (It will have the consistency of cookie dough.) Stir in apples and pecans. Spread in greased 9-x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle butterscotch chips on top. Bake at 350º for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
directions: Stir in 1 tub of Marzetti’s caramel apple dip Top with Heath Bar chips
Slice apples to place around dip.

recipes.title: Bacon Appetizer Crescents
ingredients: 2 cans (8 oz. each ) refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Mix cream cheese, bacon, Parmesan cheese, onions, parsley, and milk until well blended; set aside.

Separate each can of dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations together to seal. Spread each rectangle with 2 rounded Tbsp. of the cream cheese mixture. Cut each rectangle into 12 wedges. Roll up wedges, starting at short ends. Place, seam sides down, on greased baking sheet. Sprinkle lightly with poppy seeds (optional).
Bake for 12 – 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Bacon Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Bacon Quiche Tarts
ingredients: 2 pkgs. (3 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
directions: In a small mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and In a separate skillet, scramble the eggs. Add to milk until smooth. Add the eggs, cheese, green pepper, and onion; mix well.

Separate dough into 8 triangles; press onto the bottom and up the sides of greased muffin cups. Sprinkle half of the bacon into cups. Pour egg mixture over bacon; top with remaining bacon. Bake, uncovered, at 375º for 18-22 minutes or until a knife comes out clean. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Baked Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs. lean beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
2 lbs. lean beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
2 celery ribs, cut into ¾-inch chunks
directions: In a large bowl, mix together first 6 ingredients. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9-x 13-inch or 3-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 375º for 2 hours or until meat & vegetables are tender. Serve in bowls. This can also be made in a slow cooker.

recipes.title: Baked Beef Ziti
ingredients: 12 oz. uncooked ziti 1 tsp. dried rosemary
1 tsp. olive oil ½ tsp. table salt
2 medium garlic cloves, minced ½ tsp. black pepper
1/3 lb. lean ground beef 28 oz. can crushed tomatoes

Add oregano, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper; stir to

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Mix together:
¾ cup sugar 2 Tbsp. cornstarch
Add 2 eggs ¼ cup reserved pineapple juice 1 tsp. Vanilla
Mix well together. Place into casserole dish and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes-1 hour at 350º.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. American cheese, sliced in strips
½ lb. partially fried bacon, chopped
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Place in 9-x 13-inch pan. Top with bacon and olives. Bake 1 hour at 325º.

recipes.title: Baked Steak with Golden Mushroom Soup
directions: Roll steak in flour and brown in light olive oil until golden brown. Place in baking dish and add Campbell's Golden Mushroom Soup, mixed with 1 can of water. Pour over steak. Place sliced onions on top. Bake at 375º for 1½ hours, until tender.
Note: The soup and water makes a gravy as it bakes. Use 2 cans of water to make more gravy, especially if you use 12 pieces of steak.

recipes.title: Baked Swiss Steak
directions: Roll meat in flour and brown in olive oil. Place in large, deep baking dish. Cut onion, pepper, celery, and carrots in large pieces and add to the meat. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the meat. Bake, covered, for 2 – 2½ hours at 325º or until tender.

recipes.title: Banana Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve over salad greens.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand® Sweetened Condensed milk
Prepare pudding as directed on package.
directions: Blend in cream cheese and Eagle Brand® milk with pudding. Fold in Cool Whip®. Layer cookies, bananas, and pudding, beginning and ending with cookies, in a 9-x 13-inch pan. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding Squares
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed, divided
2 pkg. (4 serving size each) Jell-O® Vanilla
½ square Baker’s Semisweet Baking Chocolate, grated
directions: Mix wafers and butter. Press firmly onto bottom of 9-x 13-inch pan.

Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar with wooden spoon until well blended. Gently stir in 1½ cups of the whipped topping. Spoon mixture evenly onto crust; spread carefully. Cut bananas in half crosswise; cut each piece lengthwise in half. Arrange banana pieces over cream cheese mixture.

Pour milk into large bowl. Add dry pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Spoon over bananas. Spread with remaining whipped topping. Sprinkle evenly with chocolate. Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Split Delight
directions: Mix together to make crust. Bake 4 – 8 minutes at 350º.

Using electric mixer, mix in bowl for 15 minutes: 1 lb. box powdered sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs, beaten (can substitute 150 ml. of milk or 2 bananas but changes consistency) 1 stick butter (room temperature)
Pour ingredients over chilled crust.

Then pour on 2 cans crushed pineapple, drained well. Reserve syrup. Slice 4 bananas and dip in reserved juice. Place over pineapple. Top with layer of whipped topping. Garnish with walnuts or pecans (if desired) and maraschino cherries. Chocolate syrup drizzled on top is optional.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken Bites
ingredients: ½ lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into
directions: In a shallow bowl, whisk egg and milk. Place potato chips in another shallow bowl. Dip chicken in egg mixture; then roll in chips. Place in a single layer on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 400º for 10 – 15 minutes or until juices run clear. Serve with barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: BBQ Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lbs. ground meat ½ tsp. garlic powder
1 can evaporated milk ½ cup chopped onions
1 cup cracker crumbs ½ tsp. pepper
½ tsp. liquid smoke ( I leave this out.)
directions: Mix together & shape into balls; place on wax paper. Place into freezer bags and freeze. When needed, bake at 350º for 1 hour.
SAUCE
Mix together above ingredients. Heat on stovetop at medium temperature until thoroughly heated. Pour over meatballs. Serve hot.

recipes.title: BBQ Ribs
ingredients: 2 large bottles of Baby Ray’s® Honey BBQ sauce
1 bottle or can of light beer
directions: Mix in bowl. Pour over top of ribs in roasting pan. Bake at 275º for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Beef & Cheese Fold Overs
directions: Brown meat & onion; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce, set aside. Heat oven to 375º. Unroll crescent rolls into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides; firmly press perforations & edges to seal. Pat to form 15 x 13 - inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4-inch wide strip down center of dough to within 1 inch of ends. Top meat with cheese slices. Fold shorter sides of dough 1 inch over filling. Bring long sides of dough rectangle over filling, overlapping edges. Pinch edge to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 375º for 20 – 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Nacho Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350º. Brown meat and onion; drain. Stir in salsa, Miracle Whip, and chili powder. Layer ½ each of the meat mixture, chips, and cheese in 2-quart casserole. Repeat layers. Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomato, if desired.

recipes.title: Beef Patties with Gravy
ingredients: Hot cooked noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes
directions: In a bowl, combine the egg, bread crumbs and onion. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well. Shape into two patties. In a skillet, cook patties until browned on both sides. In a bowl, combine the soup, water, and mushrooms; pour over patties. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until meat is no longer pink. Serve over noodles, rice, or potatoes.

recipes.title: Best Ever Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Add flour, soda, and spices. Add 1 cup nuts and 1 cup raisins. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375º for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Betty’s Chocolate Cake
ingredients: To prepare 9-x 13-inch pan or 2 (8-inch) pans, cut
out wax paper to fit bottom of pan and then spray
sides of pan with Pam spray.
directions: Bake at 350 º for 30 minutes or until done. Don’t over bake. Cool, frost, and refrigerate.

Icing: Blend together until smooth: 1 stick butter 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese Add 2 cups powdered sugar & blend until smooth. Add 1 (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip. Frost & sprinkle with white sparkle sugar. Incredible!

recipes.title: Bisquick® Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Heat oven to 425º. Stir all ingredients except strawberries until soft dough forms. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 – 12 minutes. Split; fill and top with strawberries and whipped cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Blueberry Blintz Souffle
ingredients: 2 pkgs. (13 oz. each) frozen blueberry blintzes
directions: Place butter in a 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Top with blintzes. In a bowl, combine the eggs, sour cream, sugar, orange juice, and vanilla. Pour over blintzes.

Cover and bake at 350º for 55 minutes. Uncover; bake 10 – 15 minutes longer or until lightly browned and a knife inserted in the egg mixture comes out clean. Sprinkle with confectioners’ sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines® cake mix (Make a
2-layer cake according to directions on box.)
1 lg. container frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Cream whipped topping, cream cheese, and confectioners’ sugar together with a mixer. Place in refrigerator to cool. After baking cake according to directions on box, let cool completely. Frost first layer with about ½ inch of frosting. Add second layer and frost, making a nest-like center in the frosting. Pour blueberry filling in the middle of the nest-like center and let it drizzle down the sides of the cake.
Refrigerate.
Delicious and refreshing!

recipes.title: Blueberry Dessert Squares
ingredients: * 2 ½ cups fresh or frozen blueberries
directions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Press half of the mixture into a greased 9-inch square baking dish. Bake at 350º for 10 minutes or until brown around the edges.
Combine the blueberries and sugar; sprinkle over crust. Top with remaining oat mixture; press down gently. Bake 35 – 40 minutes longer or until golden brown. Serve warm.
*Note: If using frozen blueberries, do not thaw.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Brown sugar Nutmeg Cinnamon

Lightly spread top surface of bread slices with butter. Lay in buttered 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Combine eggs, sugar, milk, vanilla. Mix together with a wire whisk or a blender. Pour mixture over bread. The bread may not absorb all the liquid. Save the extra egg, milk mixture. Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Add the reserved liquid until all is absorbed. Sprinkle bread pudding generously with brown sugar, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Bake in a preheated 325º-350º oven for 1 hour until pudding is puffed and golden and knife inserted comes out clean. Serve at room temperature with custard sauce. Continued...

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Heat milk until scalding in saucepan. Whisk; beat eggs with sugar and flour. Pour small amount of hot milk into egg mixture, stirring well. Add egg mixture to remaining hot milk.
Cook mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly until coats metal spoon. Remove from heat and add vanilla.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
directions: Brown sausage and onion in skillet. Drain. Add diced potato.
In a separate skillet, scramble the eggs. Add to the sausage mixture. Place generous amount of cooked mixture into a steamed tortilla. Excellent served with picante sauce or salsa

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 of large block of Velveeta cheese
In large skillet, sauté onions with butter until
directions: Add frozen broccoli.
Add soup, canned milk, and salt; cook until thawed.
Add cubed Velveeta cheese.
Put cooked rice in bowl, pour cooked broccoli mix over rice, and mix all together Bake in large casserole, covered, at 350º for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1 medium bunch broccoli, cut into small florets
¼ cup finely chopped red onion
Toss broccoli, raisins, onion, and sunflower
directions: Add dressing; toss lightly. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Mix lightly just before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. thickly sliced bacon, peppered, cooked
directions: Cut broccoli into pieces. Cook bacon. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over. Marinate in refrigerator. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Broiled Cheese Delights
directions: Mix all ingredients together, using enough mayon- naise to make cheese spreadable. Line cookie sheet with slices of party rye bread. Heap cheese mixture onto bread slices. Put under broiler or bake at 350º until cheese is bubbly — bread should be crisp. Enjoy while hot!
Note: I usually bake until toast is crisp and then broil to melt cheese, if needed.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Almond Torte
directions: In a small saucepan, melt butter over moderately low heat and continue to heat until golden brown with a nut-like fragrance. (Bottom of the pan will be covered with brown specks.) Cool butter to warm and stir in vanilla.
Preheat oven to 375º. Butter and flour a 9-inch round cake pan, knocking out excess flour.
In a food processor, finely grind whole almonds with flour, ¾ cup sugar, and ½ tsp. salt. Continued . . .

In a large bowl with an electric mixer, beat whites with remaining ¼ teaspoon salt until they hold soft peaks. Add remaining ¼ cup sugar gradually, beating until meringue just holds stiff peaks. Fold in nut mixture gently but thoroughly. Fold in butter gently but thoroughly (batter will deflate) and spread in pan.
Sprinkle top of batter evenly with sliced almonds and bake torte in middle of the oven for 35 – 40 minutes, or until it begins to pull away from the side of the pan and a tester comes out clean.

Cool torte in pan on a rack for 15 minutes and invert onto the rack. Flip torte right side up and cool completely. Torte may be made one day ahead and kept in an airtight container at room temperature.

recipes.title: Brown Rim Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375º for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
ingredients: 2 ½ lbs. Shredded chicken (or 2 extra large
8 oz. Colby Jack shredded or Mexican Blend
directions: Heat chicken and hot sauce in skillet over medium heat. Do not use non-stick skillet. Shred chicken with fork.

Stir in cream cheese and melt. Stir in Ranch dressing and cheese. Pour into ungreased glass lasagna dish. Bake at 350º until hot and bubbly and golden brown. May also use a slow cooker. Serve with Scoops, tortilla chips, crackers, or celery sticks.

recipes.title: Burger Bites
ingredients: 1 large red pepper, cut into cubes
directions: Mix barbecue sauce and jelly in large skillet. Cook and stir on medium heat 2 minutes or until jelly melts.
Add meatballs to skillet; cook 10 minutes or until heated through.
Skewer each meatball alternately on long wooden skewer or toothpick with pineapple chunk and red pepper.
For variety; you can substitute seasonal fresh vegetables for the red pepper and fresh pineapple chunks for the canned pineapple.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Cake
directions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat for 10 minutes. In separate bowl, mix flour, soda, salt, and nutmeg. Alternate flour mixture and buttermilk to sugar and egg mixture until well blended. Put into 2 medium-sized and 1 small, greased loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 1½ hours. Sprinkle sugar and nutmeg on top.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: ¼ cup each of barley and rice, cooked
directions: Cut core out of cabbage head and cook cabbage in boiling, salted water until leaves remove easily. Cut thick part off end of cabbage leaf with paring knife. Put some meat into middle of each cabbage leaf. Put end over meat, tuck left side of leaf in and then finish rolling and tuck other side into meat.
Use 1 large can tomatoes and 1 large can tomato sauce and pour over cabbage rolls. Cut up pieces of celery and put on top. Place some pieces of Kielbasa around cabbage rolls.
Bake covered at 350º for 1½ hours.

recipes.title: Campfire Bundles
ingredients: 1 to 1½ lbs. fully cooked kielbasa or Polish sausage,
directions: Place the vegetables in the order listed on three pieces of double-layered heavy-duty foil (about 18-inch x 18-inch). Add the sausage; dot with butter. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Fold foil around the mixture and seal tightly.
Grill, covered, over medium heat for 30 minutes. Turn and grill 30 minutes longer or until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Caramel Sauce
directions: In a small, heavy non-aluminum saucepan, combine brown sugar and ¼ cup butter. Bring to boil over moderate heat. Whisk in the corn syrup, cream, vanilla, salt. Reduce the heat to moderately low and boil gently for about 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Immediately remove from heat and whisk the remaining ¼ cup butter. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Caramelized Onions
ingredients: Peel 2 medium onions, then cut into ¼-inch thick
slices. You should have about 2 cups onion
directions: Heat 1 Tbsp. oil in large skillet on medium heat. Add onions; cook 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Stir in 1½ tsp. sugar; cook 5 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
Drizzle with 2 Tbsp. Kraft® Special Collection Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing just before serving.
Refrigerate in a tightly covered container up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Carrot & Raisin Salad Roll-Up
ingredients: Spread flour tortilla with 1 Tbsp. Pineapple
directions: Top with 2 Tbsp. shredded carrot and 1 Tbsp. raisins; roll up.

recipes.title: Cheddar Ham Cups
ingredients: 2 cups (8 oz.) finely shredded cheddar cheese
2 pkg. (2 ½ oz. each) thinly sliced deli ham,
directions: In a large bowl, combine the cheese, ham, mayonnaise, bacon, and mustard. Split biscuits into thirds. Press onto the bottom and up the sides of ungreased miniature muffin cups. Fill each with about 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture.
Bake at 450º for 9 – 11 minutes or until golden brown and the cheese is melted. Let stand for 2 minutes before removing from the pans.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Casserole
directions: 1 lb. ground beef ¼ cup ketchup ¼ cup chopped onion 8 oz. can tomato sauce 1 tube refrigerated rolls

Brown ground beef with chopped onions and salt & pepper. Add tomato sauce and ketchup and allow to simmer. Remove from heat. In casserole put about 1/3 of hamburger mixture and 4 slices cheese. Alternate in layers with ground beef on top layer. Lay 10 rolls from a refrigerated tube on top and bake at 350º for 10 minutes or until rolls are golden brown and cooked through.
Michael Lafferty’s favorite! (Kathy’s brother)

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pitas
directions: In a large skillet, cook the beef, onion and green pepper over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Add the rice, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 – 15 minutes.
Stir in cheese; cover and cook 2 – 3 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Spoon ½ cup into each pita half.

recipes.title: Cheesy Floret Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the first 6 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 12 – 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

Meanwhile, in a small saucepan melt butter; stir in the butter until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Reduce heat; add cheese. Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Drain vegetables; add cheese sauce and heat through.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Skins
ingredients: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and rub skins with oil.
directions: Bake at 400º for 1 hour or until done. Allow potatoes to cool to touch. Cut in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp leaving ¼-inch shell. Deep fry in hot oil (375º) for 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels. Place skins on baking sheet; sprinkle with salt, cheese, and bacon. Place under broiler until cheese melts. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs. frozen hash browns, Southern style
directions: Mix all ingredients together except butter. Place in a 9-x 13-inch greased pan. Top with butter and 1 cup Corn Flakes® crumbs. Bake at 350º for 40 – 45 minutes.
Michelle’s Variation: Use O’Brien style southern potatoes (frozen). Red and green peppers and onions are included in this.
Very cheesy and tasty!

recipes.title: Chicken
directions: Mix 1 can cream of chicken soup and 1/3 cup apple juice in casserole dish. Place chicken breasts in next and poke holes in chicken with fork. Mix 1 can cream of chicken soup and 1/3 cup apple juice together and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350º for 30 minutes. Remove chicken and place cheese over each breast; cook for 10 more minutes. Pull chicken out again and sprinkle with croutons. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken & Broccoli Alfredo
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen broccoli florets
1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed
directions. Add broccoli for last 4 minutes of
In skillet, over medium-high heat, heat butter.
directions: Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often.
Add soup, milk, cheese, pepper, and fettuccine mixture and cook through, stirring often.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken and Stuffing
ingredients: 1 pkg. Stove Top® stuffing mix for chicken
Season to taste with any of the following:
directions: Place chicken in 9-x 13-inch dish. Season to taste. Stir soup and 1 can of water together; pour over chicken. Place a slice of cheese on each piece of chicken. Mix stuffing according to directions, but add more butter and onion. Using an ice cream scoop, mound stuffing on top of each piece of cheese. Bake, covered, for 1 hour and then uncover and bake 15 minutes more at 350º
My family’s favorite!

recipes.title: Chicken and Veggies in Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts (4 breasts)
1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Place chicken and vegetables in slow cooker. Mix soup mix, chicken soup, and water; then pour over chicken and veggies. Cook on high approximately 4 hours.
*You can also substitute an onion soup mix for the Knorr® soup mix.

recipes.title: Chicken Chili
directions: 3 cups cooked & cubed chicken 1 large onion, chopped 3 cans (12 oz. each) chili beans, undrained 1 can (12 oz.) chopped tomatoes, undrained 1 can (6 oz.) tomato paste 1 cup frozen corn 3 Tbsp. chili powder
Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Stir. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 pkgs. frozen broccoli 1 cup sour cream
breasts ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese
Garlic salt to taste ½ cup grated cheese
directions: • Boil chicken for ½ hour. Cut into small pieces. • Cook broccoli according to package directions. • Place a layer of broccoli and then a layer of chicken in a casserole dish. • Sprinkle with garlic salt. • Put chunks of butter on chicken. • Cover lightly with grated cheese and cheddar cheese. • Sprinkle lightly with almonds • Mix cream of chicken soup, sour cream, milk, ½ cup of grated cheese, ½ cup of shredded cheddar cheese, and sherry together and heat. • Pour over chicken and broccoli. • Sprinkle with almonds and paprika • You can put a little more cheese on before you put the almonds on. (optional) • Bake at 375º for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 – 3 lbs. cooked chicken breasts, boned (or boneless)
1 lb. grated extra sharp cheddar cheese
Sliced jalapeno peppers & black olives, optional
directions: Brown onion in butter & combine with soups, broth, green chilies & chicken. Line 9-x 13-inch baking dish with tortillas. Layer chicken mixture, grated cheese, tortillas, and cheese. Top with peppers and olives, 1 – 4 Tbsp. of each, if desired. Bake at 350º for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided 1½ tsp. ground cumin
2 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. garlic powder
1½ tsp. seasoned salt ½ tsp. chili powder
1½ tsp. dried oregano ½ tsp. paprika

1½ lbs. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips
½ medium sweet red pepper, julienned
Shredded cheddar cheese, taco sauce or salsa, and guacamole or
In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 2 Tbsp. oil,
lemon juice, and seasonings. Add chicken. Seal and turn
In a large skillet, sauté peppers and onions in remaining
oil until crisp-tender. Remove and keep warm. In the

medium-high heat for 5 – 6 minutes or until meat is no
longer pink. Return pepper mixture to pan; heat
through. Spoon filling down the center of tortillas; fold
directions: in half. Serve with cheese, taco sauce, and guacamole.

recipes.title: Chicken in Crescents
ingredients: Blend 3 oz. softened cream cheese and
directions: Add: 2 cups cooked chicken, approximately 1 lb. ¼ tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 2 Tbsp. milk 1 Tbsp. chopped onion 1 Tbsp. chopped pimento, optional

Mix well. Separate 8 oz. can of refrigerated crescent rolls into 4 rectangles. Seal the perforations. Spoon ½ cup chicken mixture into center of each rectangle. Pull up the 4 corners over center of mixture and seal. Brush top with 1 Tbsp. melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese or crushed croutons. Bake at 350º for 20 – 25 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken in Pear Sauce
ingredients: 2 – 3 medium ripe pears, peeled and diced
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. In a skillet over medium heat, cook chicken in oil on both sides for about 10 minutes or until juices run clear. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, cook bacon until crisp. Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of the drippings; set bacon aside. Gradually stir broth into the drippings, scraping pan to loosen browned bits. Bring to a boil. Boil, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until pears are tender. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth; add the chives. Gradually stir into pear sauce; bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Stir in bacon. Serve over the chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts (4 breasts)
1 small jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, or 4 slices
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Combine first three ingredients into a bowl. Place Italian dressing into separate bowl. Dip the chicken breast into the Italian dressing and then into the bread crumb mixture. Place onto a greased (I use Pam spray) 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove pan and cover chicken with spaghetti sauce and then cheese. Bake another 15 minutes or until chicken is done. Enjoy! Makes 4 servings.
Variation: Cut chicken into strips before dipping into dressing. Just bake the chicken until done. Dip in BBQ sauce or your favorite dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie Minis
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted (I use 2
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Press biscuits into greased muffin tins including up sides. Fill each biscuit with chicken mixture, pressing down with spoon to be level with top of muffin tin. Sprinkle with 2 Tbs. shredded cheese. Bake at 375º until muffins are golden brown .

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Chill several hours. Shape into 1-inch balls.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 4-pound whole chicken Salt & pepper to taste
1 (8 oz.) pkg. egg or kluski noodles
1/4 cup chicken bouillon powder or consommé
directions: Place chicken and water in a large pot over high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer, skimming fat as needed, for 30 minutes. Place halved onion, celery stalk, 1 whole carrot in pot and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Strain broth and reserve chicken. When chicken is cool enough to handle, remove skin and cut meat into bite-sized pieces. Return strained stock to pot over high heat and stir in chicken base, sliced celery, sliced carrots. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes or until car- rots are tender. Meanwhile, prepare noodles according to package direc- tions. When they are al dente , drain . Add chicken into stock pot along with parsley, salt, and pepper to taste. (I place noodles in bowl and pour soup over it so it stays “soupy.” Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 can (14 1/2 oz.) diced tomatoes with green
directions: Place chicken in slow cooker. Mix tomatoes & taco seasoning and pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 3 cans dark red kidney beans, drained
2 large cans whole tomatoes, pureed in blender
directions: Brown meat in olive oil; drain. Place into large kettle. Add kidney beans, drained; pureed toma- toes, and seasonings. Simmer on stove top for about 1 hour. Garnish with shredded cheese, sour cream, diced onions (optional).

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. chopped beef, smoked, sliced, pressed
directions: Chop up ½ package of the beef and onions. Soften cream cheese. Put all ingredients in mixer and mix together. Place in refrigerator for 10 minutes. Form into ball. Layer remaining beef in slices over cheese ball. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Chips Ahoy!® Warm S’mores
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Place 8 of the cookies, flat sides up, on foil-covered baking sheet. Top evenly with chocolate, coconut, and marshmallows.
Bake 4 minutes. Cover each with second cookie, flat side down, to make sandwich. Continue baking 2 to 4 minutes or until cookies are warmed and chocolate and marshmallows are melted.
Serve warm, or cover and refrigerate 5 to 10 minutes or until filling is set.

recipes.title: Chocolate Breeze
directions: Press into 9-x 13-inch pan and bake for 10 minutes (20 minutes for flour crust) at 350º. Cool. Mix together: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 cup powdered sugar 1 lg. container frozen whipped topping, thawed Spread on cooled crust. Mix together: 2 (3 oz.) pkgs. instant chocolate pudding 3 cups milk 1 tsp. vanilla Beat and spread over cream cheese layer. Spread a layer of whipped topping on top and garnish with nuts. Best if refrigerated for 24 hours. (May use any flavor of pudding; lemon is a nice option .)

recipes.title: Chocolate Mallow Pie
ingredients: 2 pkgs. cream cheese (one 8 oz. + one 3 oz.), softened
1 container (8 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: In a bowl, combine the cookie crumbs, butter, and sugar. Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 375º for 8 – 10 minutes or until set; cool completely on a wire rack.

In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and chocolate syrup until blended. Beat in melted chips. Set aside ¼ cup of whipped topping. Fold marshmallows and remaining whipped topping into chocolate mixture. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Garnish with reserved whipped topping and chocolate curls, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate “Coma” Trifle
ingredients: 1 (3.9 oz.) pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions and cool completely. Cut into 1-inch squares.
In a large bowl, combine pudding mix, water, and sweetened condensed milk. Mix until smooth, then fold in 8 ounces whipped topping until no streaks remain.

In a trifle bowl or glass serving dish, place half the brownies, half of the pudding mixture and half of the 12-ounce container of whipped topping. Repeat layers. Shave chocolate onto top layer for garnish. Refrigerate 8 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Christmas Fudge
directions: Bring to boil and boil for 9 min.
Remove from stove and add: 1 (13 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips 1 (8 oz.) jar marshmallow cream 1 tsp. Vanilla Nuts (optional) Beat with mixer and spread in greased pan.

recipes.title: Christmas Pickles
ingredients: Drain 1 quart dill pickles (plain Heinz® dill
pickles), cut into strips and place back in jar.
directions: Mix together:
1 ¼ cup white sugar 1 medium onion, chopped finely 2 Tbsp. vinegar 2 Tbsp. prepared horseradish
Pour over pickles and shake often over a few days. Better if prepared 3-4 days ahead of time.
This mixture may be used over and over for more pickles by adding 1½ tsp. vinegar, ¾ cup sugar, 1 Tbsp. horseradish, celery seed, and onion.
Shake jar periodically while stored in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Classic Minute Rice Pudding
ingredients: ½ cup Minute White Rice, uncooked
directions: Combine milk, rice, sugar, raisins, and salt in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer, uncovered, 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Beat egg and vanilla with wire whisk until well blended. Add a small amount of the hot milk mixture; mix well. Return to saucepan; cook and stir on low. Heat one minute. (Do not boil.)
Remove from heat. Let stand 30 minutes. Serve warm. Store any remaining pudding in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Clogger’s Delight Salad
ingredients: Break up Ramen® noodles in large bowl (do not
cook). Combine noodles, coleslaw, nuts, & onions.
directions: Mix dressing & pour over salad. Toss to coat. Add cooked, cubed chicken, if desired.

recipes.title: Cocktail Hot Dogs
directions: cut in fourths 1 (12 oz.) jar grape jelly 3 – 4 oz. yellow mustard 1 – 5 tbsp. Brown sugar

Mix jelly, mustard, and brown sugar together in a saucepan and cook over medium heat until the jelly is melted. Stir in the hot dog pieces and continue to cook over medium heat for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Keep in slow cooker on low for serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt, flour; add egg yolks and milk. Cook for 10 minutes; add coconut & vanilla and pour into a baked pie shell. Top with whipped topping or meringue. Garnish with toasted, flaked coconut.

recipes.title: Cola Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 bottles (16 oz. each) diet (or regular) cola
directions: Place meat in slow cooker. Mix mushroom soup, soup mix, and cola. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on high 6 hours.

recipes.title: Cool Cookies
ingredients: Mix, sugar, cocoa, milk, and butter in saucepan.
directions: Put on medium heat and cook until it starts to boil. Remove from heat. Cool for one minute. Add vanilla, salt, peanut butter, and oats. Stir well. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper. Let cool before eating.

recipes.title: Corn Soufflé
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in 2-quart casserole for 45 minutes at 350º.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
ingredients: Add flour mixture and mix together with mixer.
directions: Add: 1 ¾ cups dry oats (not quick) 12 oz. bag chocolate chips
Scoop onto cookie sheet; then smash with spoon. Bake for 12 – 15 minutes at 350º
Delicious!

recipes.title: Cracker Barrel Fudge Coca-Cola® Cake
ingredients: 1 cup Coca Cola® ½ tsp. salt
½ cup vegetable oil 2 eggs, beaten
2 cups granulated sugar 1 tsp. vanilla extract
directions: In a saucepan, bring Coca Cola®, oil, butter, and cocoa to a boil ; boil for 1/2 minute. Mix together the sugar, flour, and salt. Pour in the boiling liquid and extract and beat well. Pour into a greased and floured sheet cake pan, and bake at 350º for 20 – 25 minutes, depending on oven. Frosting: ½ cup butter 1 tsp. vanilla extract 3 Tbsp. cocoa ½-1 cup pecans, chopped 6 Tbsp. cream or milk 1 lb. confectioners’ sugar In a saucepan, combine the butter, cocoa, and milk. Heat until butter melts. Beat in the remaining ingredients and spread on the hot cake. Cool and cut. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cracker Barrel’s Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Defrost hash browns. Combine next 7 ingredients and mix with hash browns. Put in a 3-quart casserole. Sauté corn flakes in butter and sprinkle on top. Cover and bake at 350º for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cracker Spread
directions: Cook bacon until crisp. Mix all other ingredients and stir in bacon when cool and crumbled. Spread on crackers.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jell-O® Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and add enough water to make 2 cups of liquid. Heat and dissolve Jell-O® with this mixture. Let cool. Add ginger ale. Refrigerate until syrupy.
Beat cranberry sauce at low speed. Add pineapple and Jell-O®. Put in 9-x 13-inch dish or mold.
Beat cream cheese and add whipped topping. Spread on Jell-O® after firmly jelled. Add nuts if desired.

recipes.title: Cranberry Velvet Freeze
ingredients: 2 cans (16 oz. each) whole berry cranberry sauce
2 cans (one 20 oz., one 8 oz.) crushed pineapple,
directions: In a large bowl, combine the cranberry sauce, pineapple, marshmallows, cherries and lemon juice. Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon into an ungreased 9-x 13-inch dish. Cover and freeze overnight. Remove from the freezer 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken & Biscuits
ingredients: Boil chicken pieces (6 thighs, 8 drum sticks, and 4
directions: Cook until meat is tender and has no pink color. (About 45 minutes to an hour on medium heat. The chicken should fall off the bone.)
De-bone chicken pieces, shred chicken, and place back in the chicken broth made from cooking.

Mix in a bowl: 2 cups of flour and add in cold water until it makes a paste (not too thin.) Stir flour mixture slowly into simmering chicken pieces and broth until broth thickens. Serve over your favorite biscuits.
Can also use canned chicken and put in College Inn chicken broth — about 42 oz.
Kids love this!

recipes.title: Creamy Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of celery soup,
1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup,
1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of onion soup,
1 pkg. (16 oz.) frozen broccoli cuts, thawed
1 can (8 oz.) sliced water chestnuts, drained (optional)
directions: In a large bowl, combine the soups, cheese, and mayonnaise. Stir in the turkey, broccoli, rice, water chestnuts, and mushrooms. Transfer to a greased 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 30 minutes; stir. Sprinkle with croutons. Bake 8 – 12 minutes longer or until bubbly. Note: Reduced-fat or fat-free mayonnaise is NOT recommended for this recipe.

recipes.title: Crisp Confetti Salad
ingredients: 2 large red peppers cut into strips
1 can (15.25 oz.) tropical fruit salad, drained
½ cup Kraft® Zesty Italian Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients except dressing in large bowl. Add dressing; toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crowd Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 bunches green onions with tops, sliced
2 cans (4 oz. each ) chopped green chilies
1 can (5¾ oz.) pitted ripe olives, drained & sliced
5 cups (20 oz.) shredded cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Add 2 cups cheese. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream; add to chicken mixture and toss. Spoon into two greased 9-x 13-inch baking dishes. Sprinkle with chips. Top with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350º for 20 – 25 minutes or until hot. Yield: 24 servings.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Tortilla Chips
ingredients: Brown 1 lb. ground beef in a skillet. Add ½ cup
salsa and 1 package taco seasoning mix.
directions: Place a few handfuls tortilla chips in baking dish. Top with half of the ground beef, chopped tomatoes, and shredded Mexican Style Taco Shredded Cheese. Repeat layers.
Bake at 400º for 8 minutes, or until cheese melts. Top tortilla chips with guacamole, sour cream, and more salsa.
Note: You may brown meat with seasoning ahead of time and refrigerate until ready to assemble.

recipes.title: Crunchy Bacon Cole Slaw
directions: Mix Miracle Whip® and sugar in large bowl. Add cabbage, peanuts, and bacon; toss. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Crunchy Holiday Turkey Salad
ingredients: ¼ cup finely chopped green onions
directions: Mix dressing, vegetables, and cranberries in large bowl. Add turkey; mix lightly. Cover. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Crème de Menthe Brownies
ingredients: Preheat oven to 350º. Cream butter and sugar in large
mixing bowl at medium speed until light and fluffy. Beat
eggs, syrup, and vanilla. Add flour and salt; mix at low
speed until blended. Spread batter into a greased
9-x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 – 25 minutes or until
a wooden toothpick comes out clean. Cool on rack.
Combine confectioners’ sugar, butter, and crème de menthe
in a small bowl at low speed. Spread over cooled brownie
directions: Continued...

recipes.title: Crème de Menthe Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate chip pieces and butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir occasionally. Cool and spread over the second layer.
Chill brownies in the refrigerator and cut into 32 – 40 squares. Store in a covered pan in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Dairy Delicious Dip
directions: In a small mixing bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, sug- ars, and syrup to taste. Beat until smooth. Chill. Serve with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into
1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Cook chicken in dressing in large skillet on medium heat for 2 minutes. Add cream cheese; cook and stir until melted. Add flour; mix well. Add broth and vegetables; simmer 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into deep dish 10-inch pie plate. Arrange pie crust over filling; flute edges. Cut four slits in crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

recipes.title: Deep-Dish Turkey Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. (6 oz.) Stove Top® Stuffing Mix for Chick-
1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Add water to stuffing mix; stir just until moistened. Set aside.
Place turkey and vegetables in 2-quart casserole dish. Pour gravy over turkey mixture. Stir gently, then top with prepared stuffing. Bake 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Delicious Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 – 4 lb. beef round or chuck roast
1 pkg. Lipton onion soup mix, dry
directions: Place meat, vegetables, soup mix , and water in slow cooker, placing vegetables on bottom. Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Delicious Slow Cooker Chicken
ingredients: Make Italian dressing as directed on package.
directions: Place chicken and vegetables in slow cooker, placing vegetables on bottom. Pour dressing over meat and vegetables. Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.
Note: Can substitute 8 oz. of bottled Italian dressing

recipes.title: Dip in Rye Bread
ingredients: Mix. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Hollow
out loaf of round rye bread and fill with dip.
directions: Serve with pieces of rye bread and vegetables.

recipes.title: Dutch Brown Bread
ingredients: Preheat oven to 350º. Grease and flour or grease and sugar
Step 1: Combine dry ingredients in bowl and stir together.
Step 2: In separate bowl, combine oil and sugars with a
Step 3: Add 2 eggs to the sugar and oil mixture and beat
Step 4: Add alternately to the sugar and oil mixture, a
little flour mixture and a little buttermilk, then mix with
mixer, then add some more flour and more buttermilk until
gone. You will use 2 cups of buttermilk total.
Step 5: Pour into 2 bread pans and bake for 1 hour or until
cake tester comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes; then
remove from pans onto a cooling rack. When cool, wrap in
aluminum foil. Keeps 1 month in Tupperware® in
refrigerator or freezes well in foil.
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Grease and flour or grease and sugar 2 loaf pans. 4 cups flour 2 tsp. ground cloves 2 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. salt 2 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. nutmeg Step 1: Combine dry ingredients in bowl and stir together. 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup oil 2 cups white sugar Step 2: In separate bowl, combine oil and sugars with a hand mixer. Step 3: Add 2 eggs to the sugar and oil mixture and beat well.
