When cool, wrap in aluminum foil. Keeps 1 month in Tupperware® in refrigerator or freezes well in foil.

recipes.title: Easy Cheesy Corn Bake
ingredients: 1 can (15½ oz.) whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Whisk cream cheese and milk until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended.
Pour into 9-x 13-inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray.
Bake 35 – 36 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Fajita Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into
2 cups coarsely chopped mixed red and green peppers
½ lb. (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese, cut up
directions: 1) Cook chicken and seasonings in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat for 5 – 7 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally.
2) Stir in 2¼ cups water. Bring to boil. Stir in macaroni; cover. Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer 5 minutes. Add peppers and onions; cover and simmer an additional 5 minutes.
3) Add Velveeta; cook until melted, stirring frequently.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Parmesan
directions: Pour spaghetti sauce into jelly roll pan (15-x 10-inch) Combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Dip chicken in butter; coat with crumbs. Place chicken over spaghetti sauce in pan. Bake at 400º for 25 minutes. Top with mozzarella cheese. Bake an additional 5 minutes.
Serve over cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Easy Parmesan Chicken Fingers
ingredients: Preheat oven to 400º. Moisten with water 2
pounds chicken tenders or boneless, skinless
chicken breasts, cut into strips. Shake off excess
water. Add 1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese to 1
pouch Shake ‘N Bake Extra Crispy Seasoned
directions: Add 2 or 3 chicken tenders to shaker bag and shake until evenly coated. Repeat with remaining chicken tenders. Place on nonstick baking sheet or baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Discard any remaining coating mixture in shaker bag.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Serve with 1 cup barbecue sauce for dipping, if desired.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Drain and add: 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 small can enchilada sauce 1 can chopped green chilies
Simmer for 10 minutes. Layer 1 bag of nacho chips in 9-x 13-inch pan. Pour mixture on top; cover with 2 cups of shredded cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: English Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese and Old English cheese in mixer until well blended Chill 2 hours. Form into 2 balls. Roll in chopped nuts. Serve with Ritz pretzel crackers.

recipes.title: English Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese and Old English cheese in mixer until well blended. Chill for 2 hours. Form into 2 balls. Roll in nuts. Serve with pretzel crackers.

recipes.title: English Walnut Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt butter with flour; make paste. Then add chicken stock and milk. Stir and cook over heat until thick sauce forms. Pour over broccoli.
rd 3 layer: ½ box Kellogg’s® croutons (herb seasoned) 6 Tbsp. butter, melted with ½ cup water 2/3 cup chopped walnuts
Mix croutons with melted butter, water, and walnuts. Mix well. Spread over sauce. Cover with foil. Bake at 350º for ½ hour.

recipes.title: Escalloped Potatoes
directions: Grease dish. Place one layer of potatoes in dish. Sprinkle with salt & pepper, flour, and pats of butter. Continue to layer until all potatoes are gone. Pour canned milk over potatoes, completely covering. If you need more milk, you may use regular milk. Cover and place in 425º oven. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese for the last few minutes of cooking. (You will have to learn the consistency of the flour, etc. Practice makes perfect!)

recipes.title: Farmhouse Barbecue Muffins
ingredients: Separate dough into 10 biscuits; flatten into 5-inch
circles. Press each into the bottom and up the sides of a
greased muffin cup; set aside. In a skillet, brown ground
beef; drain. In a small bowl, mix ketchup, brown sugar,
vinegar and chili powder; stir until smooth. Add to meat
Divide the meat mixture among biscuit-lined muffin cups,
directions: using about ¼ cup for each. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375º for 18 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from tin and serving.
Note: You may substitute your favorite Sloppy Joes recipe. I sometimes use Manwich® and “doctor it up.”

recipes.title: Favorite Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 bone-in pork loin chops (1½ – inch thick)
directions: In a saucepan over medium heat, bring soy sauce, water, brown sugar, and molasses to a boil. Remove from the heat; cool to room temperature. Pour into a large resealable plastic bag; add pork chops. Seal bag and refrigerate for 3 – 6 hours.

Drain and discard marinade. Place pork chops in a greased 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and bake at 350º for 30 minutes. Combine the sauce ingredients; pour over chops. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes longer or until meat juices run clear.

recipes.title: Festive Strawberry Nut Salad
ingredients: 2 cups packed torn fresh spinach leaves
Toss almonds with sugar in medium nonstick
skillet; cook on medium heat 6 – 8 minutes or
until sugar forms a golden brown syrup and
evenly coats the almonds, stirring constantly.
directions: Spread into single layer on greased baking sheet or sheet of wax paper; cool. Break into small pieces.
Toss spinach leaves, Boston lettuce, and halved strawberries in a large bowl.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving; mix lightly. Sprinkle with almonds. Serve on chilled plates.

recipes.title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cans (17 oz. each ) fruit cocktail, divided
2 cans (11 oz. each ) mandarin oranges, divided
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 cup juice in a small saucepan. Set pineapple aside. To saucepan, add sugar, flour, eggs, orange juice, lemon juice, and oil. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute; remove from the heat and let cool. In a salad bowl, combine pineapple, fruit cocktail, oranges, and bananas. Fold in whipped cream and the cooled sauce. Chill for several hours.

recipes.title: Fluffy White Frosting
ingredients: ¼ tsp. cream of tartar (can omit)
directions: Combine sugar, Karo® syrup, and water. Let come to boil and thicken. It is done when it is stringy from a spoon).
Slowly pour ½ of the syrup into beaten egg whites. Cook remaining syrup for 2 minutes. Add rest of syrup. Beat well (until it loses its gloss). Spread on cake.
If consistency is not right, add powdered sugar. Keep refrigerated. Best on chocolate cake!

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Cobbler
ingredients: Place layer of fresh peaches in 12-oz. glass baking
directions: Add: ½ cup milk ¼ tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 cup flour
Pour batter over peaches.
Mix together and stir until dissolved: 1 cup sugar ½ cup water Pour over top of batter. Bake at 325º until brown. Dough will rise to top.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken West V irginia Style
ingredients: Lay chicken pieces out on wax paper for 1 hour before
cooking. (Your choice of chicken pieces — chicken
30 minutes before frying, season chicken with salt, pepper,
garlic salt, paprika, and roll in flour.
Let chicken stand for 30 minutes. Moisture from chicken
Just before placing chicken into frying pan with olive oil
heated to 425º, roll chicken again in flour. The moisture
will pick up more breading, and it will be crispier.
directions: Place chicken in hot oil, turning often, for 30 to 40 minutes, (depending on the size of chicken pieces).
Turn heat down after initial browning of chicken; and before removing chicken from pan, turn heat back up to 425º to make chicken crispy.

recipes.title: Friendship Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients. Shake well to blend. Keep in glass jar. Use 2 – 3 Tbsp. of dry mixture added to boiling water to serve.

recipes.title: Frosted 7-Up® Fruit Jell-O® Salad
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) pkgs. orange Jell-O® (I use sugar free)
1 can crushed pineapple in its own juice, drained
1 cup whipped cream or whipped topping
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add soda and chill until partially set. Add remaining fruit and marshmallows and chill.

For the topping, combine sugar and flour in a saucepan. Stir in pineapple juice and egg. Continue stirring constantly until thick; add butter. Cool. Fold in whipped topping and spread over gelatin. If desired, sprinkle with cheese. (My personal favorite.)

recipes.title: Frozen Cocktail Salad
ingredients: 2 medium bananas, cut into ¼-inch pieces
directions: Mix sour cream, sugar, & lemon juice. Stir in fruit, bananas, nuts, & cherries. Place into 2 ice trays or Pyrex® dish. Freeze for 24 hours. About 15 minutes before serving, place in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Banana Salad
ingredients: 5 medium firm bananas, halved lengthwise and
1 carton (12 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Drain pineapple juice into a medium bowl; set pineapple aside. Add bananas to the juice. In a large bowl, combine cranberry sauce and sugar. Remove bananas, discarding juice, and add to cranberry mixture. Stir in pineapple, whipped topping and nuts. Pour into a 9-x 13-inch dish. Freeze until solid. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Pour into buttered 9-x 13-inch pan.

Sweeten 2 – 3 cups desired fruit with sugar (blackberries, peaches, cherries). Pour over batter. Bake for 30 minutes at 425º. When serving, top with whipped cream. You may also bake the cake by itself. Then pour strawberries over like you would for a shortcake.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Pour 2 cans pie filling of your choice in 9-x 13-inch baking dish.
Drop lumps of sugar cookie dough onto filling.
Sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and sugar.
Bake at 350º for 30 – 40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Whip together with spoon until smooth. Serve with fresh fruit. Yummy!

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Sugar Cookie Mix
1 large can crushed pineapple, well drained
1 large can mandarin oranges, well drained
3 – 4 bananas, sliced (dip in lemon juice or fruit fresh)
Prepare cookie mix according to package directions for
“rolled and cut cookies.” Pat into large pizza pan.
directions: Bake 9 – 10 minutes at 350º or until lightly browned. Mix cream cheese and confectioners’ sugar until fluffy and spread on cooled crust. Layer pineapple, bananas, oranges; then place strawberries over cream cheese. Spoon glaze over fruit. Refrigerate. Glaze: 2 cups sugar 2 Tbsp. light Karo® syrup 6 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 small pkg. strawberry Jell-O® 2 cups water
Combine all ingredients (except Jell-O® and cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly. Stir in Jell-O®. Cool in refrigerator before putting on pizza.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad & Dressing
directions: Blend until smooth. Spoon over fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Fruit-Filled Pastry
directions: Arrange crescent rolls on baking stone with point toward the center. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, egg, and vanilla in a bowl. Spread cream cheese mixture over crescent rolls. Spread pie filling over cream mixture. Turn edges of crescent rolls toward the center. Bake for 20 – 25 minutes at 350º.

recipes.title: Fruited Rice Pilaf
ingredients: ¼ cup prepared Italian salad dressing
directions: Cook rice pilaf according to package directions. Stir in the butter until melted. Add the pineapple, raisins, and salad dressing. Top with toasted coconut if desired.

recipes.title: Gary’s Baked Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 325º for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Glorified Grahams
ingredients: Line a jelly roll pan with 24 graham
cracker squares. Mix ½ cup melted butter
and ½ cup brown sugar and spoon onto
directions: Line a jelly roll pan with 24 graham cracker squares. Mix ½ cup melted butter and ½ cup brown sugar and spoon onto grahams. Sprinkle with 1 cup chopped nuts. Bake for 10 – 12 minutes at 350º.

recipes.title: Golden Mushroom Pork and Apples
directions: Mix soup, water, brown sugar, Worcestershire and thyme in 3 ½-quart slow cooker. Add pork, apples and onions.
Cover and cook on low 8 – 9 hours or on high 4 – 5 hours, or until pork is no longer pink.

recipes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients: ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 425º. Rinse potatoes; drain on paper towels, then pat dry.

Brush 1 Tbsp. of the butter onto bottom and side of 9-inch pie plate. Toss potatoes with combined remaining 2 Tbsp. butter and ¼ cup of the cheese; arrange potato slices, in several layers, on bottom and up side of pie plate. Sprinkle with remaining ¼ cup cheese.
Bake 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Loosen potatoes from side and bottom of pie plate. Invert immediately onto serving plate; sprinkle with chives. Cut into 8 wedges to serve.

recipes.title: Governor Arch Moore’s Casserole
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce ( for *2# meat I use
Brown meat in butter (or olive oil) and add
tomato sauce. Cook noodles according to
package directions. Butter a 2½-quart casserole and
spread half of the noodles on the bottom. Layer
cottage cheese, soft cream cheese, sour cream, and
chopped mixtures. Spread remainder of noodles over
this, and then add the browned meat and tomato
directions: * Even with 2lbs. of meat, keep other
sauce mixture. Pour melt ed butter over the top and bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350 º .

recipes.title: Grandma’s Angel Food Cake Icing
directions: Cream together all ingredients and beat until creamy. Double the recipe. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Granny's Potato Salad
ingredients: Hard boiled eggs (1/2 to 1 dozen), chopped
Candied sweet dill pickles, diced (Candied sweet dill
directions: Boil potatoes, peel skin off, and then cube. Add remaining ingredients. Amount of ingredients varies according to amount of potatoes.
Blend together: ½cup Mayonnaise ½cup Miracle Whip® Sugar A little juice from the sweet dill pickles A little mustard A little milk
Shake together and add to potatoes. Garnish with paprika. Chill before serving. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Granny’s Beef Soup
directions: Boil 2 lbs. beef tips or beef stew meat, cubed (until tender) Add : 4 lbs. cubed potatoes 5 stalks of celery, cut up 2 large onions 8 carrot sticks, diced Salt & pepper to taste Add crushed red pepper to taste Add 1 large can of tomato juice and let simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Granny’s Cream Pie
directions: Stir well and cook until thick.
Add: 2 Tbsp. butter 2 tsp. vanilla Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue or whipped topping.
Note: To make chocolate cream pie, add ½ cup Hershey’s® cocoa. Top with whipped topping or meringue.
To make coconut pie, add 1 cup flaked coconut. Top with whipped topping or meringue and garnish with toasted coconut flakes.

recipes.title: Granny’s Pie Meringue
directions: Cook until thick (cool completely).
Beat 6 egg whites until stiff, and add 12 Tbsp. white sugar.
Then add cooled ingredients to egg whites and mix well until fluffy.
Spread on top of pie.
Brown meringue under broiler until peaks look golden.
Makes enough meringue for 2 pies.

recipes.title: Granny’s Pineapple Pie
directions: Stir in 2 cans crushed pineapple. Cook over medium heat, stirring until it thickens. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan and top with pie crust. (I use Pillsbury® ready-made pie crust.) Bake at 425º for 25-30 min.
Liz’s favorite!

recipes.title: Grape Salad
ingredients: Wash grapes and dry thoroughly so that there is no
moisture remaining on grapes. Place them in a casserole
directions: Cream together: sour cream, cream cheese, and granulated sugar. Pour over grapes and mix.
In a separate bowl, mix brown sugar and pecans. Sprinkle on top. Refrigerate.

Note: Char says you could double the amount of grapes for this same amount of cream cheese mixture. If you only use 4 pounds of grapes, you may not want to use the entire amount of cream cheese mixture as it is too sweet. Delicious!

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkgs. frozen French cut green beans
directions: Melt butter and stir in flour, salt, pepper, sugar, and onions. Add sour cream and stir until thick. Fold in cooked, drained green beans. Grate onions and sprinkle over beans. Place in 9-x 13-inch casserole. Crush Corn Flakes® and mix with butter. Put on top of casserole. Bake at 350º for 45 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Ham Barbeque
directions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes over medium-high heat. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Hamburger Corn Pone Pie
ingredients: 1 cup tomato juice ( I add a little more for moisture)
directions: Add a little sugar

Brown hamburger with onions, salt, & chili powder. Add tomato juice, beans, and macaroni. Pour into baking dish. Make corn bread according to package directions. ( I add a little sugar.) Pour corn bread mix over meat mixture. Bake uncovered until corn bread is lightly browned on top at 400º. Make sure corn bread is done all the way through.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can mushroom or cream of chicken soup, undiluted
Garlic, to taste (powder, salt, or minced)
directions: Brown ground beef & onion in olive oil. Add flour & simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste. Stir in soup & mushrooms. Simmer for 10 minutes, uncovered. Stir in sour cream and heat through.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake
directions: Mix together with spoon, not mixer. Bake at 350º in 9-x13-inch pan for 45 minutes.
Icing: 8 oz. cream cheese ½ cup butter 1 tsp. vanilla 1 ½ cups sifted confectioners’ sugar
Spread icing over cooled cake. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Pour into ungreased 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350º for 25-30 minutes. Cool and frost. Keep cake in refrigerator.
Topping:
Beat all ingredients together. Frost cake.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
directions: Melt butter and stir in crumbs. Press into the bottom of pan. Combine other ingredients and pour into pan. Bake 25 – 30 minutes at 350º. Let cool. Cut into small squares.
Use 9-inch square pan or double the recipe and put in a 9-x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Hershey Bar Pie
directions: Melt bars, mix in whipped topping. Place in pie shell. Refrigerate. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Hershey Cake
ingredients: Bake 1 box of Swiss Chocolate Cake mix
directions: Icing: 8 Hershey® bars crushed (easier if frozen) 1(8 oz.) package cream cheese 1 cup confectioners’ sugar ½ cup white sugar 1(8 oz.) tub frozen whipped topping, thawed
Spread icing over cooked cake & garnish with 2 crushed Hershey® bars. Refrigerate.
Awesome!

recipes.title: Ho Ho Cake
directions: 1 box chocolate cake mix
Topping: White icing:

Bake cake following directions on the box. Create icing by creaming Crisco® and butter together. Add milk, vanilla, and salt. Gradually add in powdered sugar and beat for 10-15 minutes. Refrigerate until fluffy and spread over cake. Beat topping ingredients together and spread over white icing. (Icing should be thin enough to spread. If necessary, add water.) (You may need to add more butter & hot water to compensate for the egg or use liquid pasteurized eggs.) Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Holiday Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) cream cheese (add a little at a time to hot
directions: Beat until smooth.
Mix the following & add to potatoes:
2 eggs lightly beaten 1 tsp. salt Dash of pepper
Grease 9-x13-inch pan. Pour potatoes into pan, cover, and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350º for 45 minutes until light brown on top.

recipes.title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown meat with onions & celery. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 1 – 1½ hours.

recipes.title: Homemade Snicker Bars
directions: 1 layer: Melt 1 cup chocolate chips, ¼ cup peanut butter, and ¼ cup butterscotch chips. Spread in the bottom of a greased 9-x 13-inch cake pan. Let cool.

2 layer: Boil 1 cup sugar, ¼ cup canned milk, and ¼ cup butter for 5 minutes. Add ¼ cup peanut butter, 1½ cups marshmallow crème, and 1 tsp. vanilla. Mix in 1¼ cup salted peanuts. Spread over first layer and cool.
3 layer: Melt one package (11.5 oz.) caramels and 4 Tbsp. Carnation® milk . Spread over second layer and cool.
4 layer: Repeat First Layer. Spread over caramels and cool. Cut into squares. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Honey Fruit Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine the bananas and berries. In a small bowl, combine the honey, lemon juice and poppy seeds. Pour over fruit and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise (add a little more to make
directions: Combine chicken, celery, and almonds with mayonnaise. Mix together onion, salt, and lemon juice; add to chicken. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Top with potato chips and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 450º for about 20 minutes. Serves 6.
(May be made ahead of time — except put topping on just before placing in oven.)

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Use 1/3 cup mix with boiling water to fill mug. Makes about 80 cups.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Cream together cream cheese, then add all other ingredients. Bake at 350º for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Dried Beef Dip
directions: Blend together and bake at 350º for 15 minutes. Serve with veggies or assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cans (15¼ oz. each) sliced pears, undrained
directions: In a 3-quart slow cooker, combine the sugar, butter, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or until heated through.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Mix # 1: 1 cup brown sugar, packed ¼ cup cocoa Set aside.
Mix # 2: 1 cup flour 2 Tbsp. oil 2 tsp. baking powder ¾ cup sugar 2 Tbsp. cocoa ¼ tsp. salt ½ cup milk 1 cup nuts

Stir ingredients together. Spread in 9-inch square pan (ungreased). Sift or sprinkle Mixture number 1 on top of Mixture number 2. Pour 1¾ cups hot water on top of mixture in pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350º. When cutting, invert before placing on dish. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Hot Mexican Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and seasoning mix. Spread on the bottom of a 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish. Layer remaining ingredients over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350º for 20 minutes or until the center is bubbly. Garnish with lettuce and cherry tomatoes. Serve with tortilla chips.
One of John’s favorites!

recipes.title: Hot Sausage Appetizers
directions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400º for 15 – 20 minutes. May be prepared ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Hunts Burgers
directions: Hollow out center of top portion of buns. Crumble up removed portion of bread & use it in meat mixture.
Use 1½ cans of tomato sauce in the meat mixture. Bake at 375º for 25 minutes. Put remaining sauce on meat in bun hole. Bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Icing
directions: Add more water if needed for correct consistency.

recipes.title: Irish Baked Corn
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and garlic to taste (optional)
directions: Mix first five ingredients. Add muffin mix. Pour into a greased 9-x13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350° until set.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Mix together:
Mix in:

Separate 5 eggs; mix yolk of egg into mixture. Beat egg whites until fluffy and fold into mixture. Fold in 2 cups of coconut & 1 cup of chopped pecans. Bake in 3 (8-or 9-) inch pie pans at 350º. ICING
Mix ingredients together and spread over cooled cake. Refrigerate after icing.

recipes.title: John’s Favorite Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 ¼ cup graham cracker crumbs 1½ Tbsp. lemon juice
¼ cup butter, melted ¾ tsp. Vanilla
11 oz. cream cheese, softened Dash of salt
directions: Mix crumbs and butter in deep pie plate. Beat cream cheese. Blend in sugar, lemon juice, vanilla, and salt. Add eggs, one at a time. Pour into crust. Bake at 325º for 25-30 minutes. (Center will not be firm.) Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, mix together:
Spoon sour cream mixture on top of pie, beginning from outside edges and working toward the center of pie plate. Bake 10-20 minutes more (until it loses its gloss. Cool and then refrigerate, covered.

recipes.title: Kathy Spencer’s Favorite Ham Glaze
directions: Baste for last 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: ¾ cups fresh lime juice (about 7 limes)
directions: Mix together and pour into crust.
Meringue topping:
Whip until stiff peaks:
3 egg whites 1 tsp. Vanilla
Gradually add in 6 Tbsp. sugar. Whip until stiff. Place on pie. Bake at 350º until meringue browns.

recipes.title: Kielbasa in BBQ Sauce
directions: Simmer ½ hour. Add kielbasa pieces, boiled. Simmer until meat is heated through.
Variation: Cook 1 grated onion and 1 minced clove of garlic for 5 minutes in butter and add to sauce.

recipes.title: Krispy Bars
ingredients: Mix and bake 15 minutes in greased
Add on top : 4 cups mini marshmallows, heated in
Heat on stove and mix together:
Spoon mixture on top of marshmallows. Chill.
directions: 2/3 cup Karo® syrup

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 2 envelopes (1½ oz. each) Lawry’s Italian style spaghetti
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Large container cottage cheese 3 packages mozzarella cheese 2 packages lasagna noodles, cooked & drained
Arrange one layer of noodles on bottom of pan. Add layer of sauce. Add 1/3 of cottage cheese and 1/3 of mozzarella cheese. Repeat 2 more times.
Bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Layered Lettuce Salad
directions: Cover and place in refrigerator for 24 hours. May also use 1½ cups mayonnaise and 1½ cups Hidden Valley® Ranch Dressing in place of the 2 cups mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Lazy Man’s Cabbage Roll Casserole
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cut up in pieces, or shredded
1½ lb. ground beef (or 1 lb. ground beef & ½ lb. sausage)
directions: Boil cabbage until slightly soft, but done completely; drain water. Brown the ground meat and onion in small amount of olive oil. Add salt & pepper. Cook the rice according to package directions. Mix rice and meat together.
Mix together: 1 can tomato soup with 1 can water 4 oz. can of tomato sauce Add a little sugar, to taste
Layer the cabbage, meat & sauce mixture in a casserole dish, ending with cabbage on top. Bake at 350º for 1 hour, covered. Place shredded cheddar cheese on top and bake uncovered for 30 more minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Honey Chicken
ingredients: 4 cups Pepperidge Farm® Herb Seasoned Stuffing
2 Tbsp. each honey and lemon juice
directions: In saucepan, mix broth and carrots. Over medium-high heat, heat to a boil; remove from heat. Add stuffing. Mix lightly.
Spoon into greased 3-quart, shallow baking dish. Arrange chicken over stuffing. Bake at 375º for 50 minutes.
Mix honey, lemon juice, and parsley. Brush over chicken. Place lemon slices on chicken. Bake 10 minutes or until chicken is done and no longer pink. Stir stuffing.

recipes.title: Lemonade Punch
directions: Place frozen lemonade in punch bowl. Pour Sprite over it. Refreshing and not too sweet. Regf

recipes.title: Liz’s Favorite Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs. Mash bananas and add to mixture. Add sour cream. Mix together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and add to mixture. Add nuts. Pour mixture into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350º for 40 minutes .

recipes.title: Liz’s Favorite Chicken & Noodles
ingredients: 1 large can of College Inn® Chicken Broth
directions: Heat on stove top until boiling. Place 1 (24 oz.) pkg. Reames® Frozen Noodles into broth Salt and Pepper to taste. Cook according to directions on package.

***To make noodles more appealing, you can add a drop or 2 of yellow food coloring. You may also add canned white chicken breast, drained or breast of chicken that has been boiled and cut into small pieces.

recipes.title: Macaroni &Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni and drain. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350º for 30 – 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese Chicken Casserole
ingredients: Make your own recipe of macaroni and cheese.
directions: Add 1 cup cooked chicken breast, cubed (or a can of chicken breast, drained) (may also use cubed ham or turkey) 1 can cream of chicken soup ½ soup can of milk
Mix ingredients well and place in casserole dish. Crumble Ritz® crackers on top and dot with pats of butter. Bake at 350º for 30 minutes.
Great for leftover ham or turkey.

recipes.title: Maltby Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350 º . Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Pour into 2 lightly greased 8-inch round pans. Bake for 30 minutes; cool completely.
Frosting: 1 pint fresh whipping cream 1 Tbsp. instant vanilla pudding Mix together on high speed until fluffy. Spread on cake; garnish with chocolate chips and strawberries, if desired.

recipes.title: Mandarin Chicken Salad
directions: In a medium bowl, combine first eight ingredients; mix well. Cover and chill for 1 – 2 hours. Fold in pecans just before serving.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 4 eggs (3 if large or extra large)
1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges with juice
directions: Mix all ingredients together, using spoon. Bake in 2 (9-inch) round cake pans at 350 º for 25-30 minutes. Cool. Split each cake in half so there are 4 layers.
Topping: Mix 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice with 1 small box instant vanilla pudding. Fold in 9 oz. + more Cool Whip. Frost. Keep refrigerated after frosting.

recipes.title: Maple – Baked Apple Chicken
ingredients: ½ cup maple-flavored syrup or honey
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Spray large nonstick ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Heat on medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned on both sides. Remove from heat.
Place onion on top of chicken; place apples around sides of chicken. Mix syrup and dressing; pour over chicken.
Bake 20 – 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Spoon syrup mixture in skillet over chicken just before serving.

recipes.title: Marinade for Beef Brisket
ingredients: Combine all ingredients. Brush on both sides of meat.
Wrap in foil; refrigerate overnight. Leave in foil. Bake at
directions: 1 tsp. liquid smoke 1 Tbsp. soy sauce 1 tsp. celery salt 1 tsp. onion salt 1 tsp. black pepper 1 tsp. garlic salt 2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce

recipes.title: Marvelous Mini Meat Loaves
ingredients: 1 lb. ground turkey (or lean ground beef)
1 pkg. (6 oz.) Stove Topº Stuffing mix
directions: 1 cup tomato juice ( I add a little more for moisture)

Preheat oven to 375°. Mix meat, stuffing mix, water, and seasoning until well blended. Press evenly into 12 muffin cups sprayed with cooking spray; make indentation in center of each with back of spoon. Spoon sauce evenly into indentations.

Bake 30 minutes or until meat loaves are cooked through (160° F). Top evenly with cheese; Make corn bread according to package directions. ( I continue baking 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Note: You may use your favorite meat loaf recipe and follow the same procedure.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Beat 1 large package cream cheese; then add 1 cup sour cream and 1 stick of butter.
Add the potatoes.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle paprika on top.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350º.

recipes.title: Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Work with hands by dipping hands into cool water before rolling. This gives meatballs a smooth surface. Put in spaghetti sauce and cook for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Melba Toast Rounds
directions: Mix together: ½ lb. bacon, fried, drained, crumbled ½ cup green onion and tops, diced ¼ cup mayonnaise
Place Melba toast rounds on cookie sheet. Spread with mixture. Heat in oven at 350º

recipes.title: Mexican Bake
ingredients: Chi Chi’s brand corn cake mix
Brown meat and add taco seasoning according to package
Add verde sauce to meat mixture.
Place meat mixture in rectangular pan; place salsa over
meat mixture evenly. Place olives on top, if desired.
Make corn cake mix according to package directions.
directions: Spread evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 350 º for 45 minutes.
Cut in squares and garnish with sour cream.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix and bake @ 400º for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Michigan Spud Bake
directions: Cook potatoes in skins until done, but firm. Drain and refrigerate overnight. Grate potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix together sour cream, butter, onion, salt, and pepper. Gently fold in above mixture. Bake at 375º for 30 – 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Combine candy bars and butter in saucepan. Place over low heat until melted, stirring constantly. Combine sugar and shortening; beat until creamy. Add eggs and continue beating until light and fluffy.
Combine flour and salt; combine buttermilk and soda. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture, beating well after addition. Stir in vanilla and candy bar mixture.
Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350º for 30 minutes or until done. When layers are completely cool, frost with chocolate marshmallow frosting.
Continued...
Chocolate Marshmallow Frosting
2 cups sugar 1 (13 oz.) can evaporated milk ½ cup butter 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semisweet chocolate pieces 1 cup marshmallow cream

Combine sugar, milk, and butter in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until a small amount dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat and add chocolate pieces and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted.

recipes.title: Mini Taco Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup salsa ¼ cup ranch dressing
½ cup shredded cheddar cheese or sour cream
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Microwave tortillas on high for 30 seconds or until softened.
Press 1 tortilla into each of 8 muffin cups to form a bowl. Carefully fold edges of tortilla back to keep an opening for the filling. Bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, brown meat in a large skillet on medium heat. Drain. Stir in salsa; bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium low; simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cut lettuce with clean kitchen shears (about 2 cups, chopped). Chop tomato into ¼-inch pieces with knife (about 1 cup, chopped).
Spoon about ¼ cup of the meat mixture into each tortilla bowl. Top evenly with cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes. Drizzle with dressing or sour cream.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until thick. Combine flour, butter, cocoa, vanilla, coconut, and nuts. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350º. While cake is still hot, spread marshmallow crème over and let stand until it melts.
Icing:
Melt butter and then add all ingredients, except nuts. Spread over cooled cake. Place whole nuts on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Mozzarella-Beef Burgers
ingredients: ½ cup Kraft Thick ‘N Spicy Original Barbecue
directions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Mix meat, cheese, bread crumbs, and 2 Tbsp. of the barbecue sauce. Shape into 4 patties.

Place patties on grill’ and cover grill with lid. Grill 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until burgers are cooked through, brushing with remaining 2 Tbsp. barbecue sauce during last 2 minutes of grilling time.
Fill buns with burgers and lettuce, if desired.
Options: Add 2 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese and ¼ tsp. Italian seasoning to the meat mixture. Serve with lettuce and pickles.

recipes.title: Napa Valley Salad
ingredients: 2 pkgs. dry Ramen® noodles (any flavor soup — throw
directions: Dressing ~ Mix together and store in refrigerator: 1 cup sugar 1 cup salad oil 1 cup vinegar ½ cup soy sauce

Break up Ramen® noodles and sauté in melted butter until they begin to brown; add almonds and sunflower kernels and continue cooking until all are golden brown. Cool and place in separate container to preserve crispness.
When ready to serve , mix cabbage, onions, and ½ the noodle/nut mixture. Serve dressing either mixed in or on the side.

recipes.title: No Peek Chicken
ingredients: 1 small box Uncle Ben’s® Long Grain
directions: Lightly grease 9-x 13-inch dish. Mix first 6 ingredients and place in pan. Lay chicken on top and sprinkle with the Lipton® soup mix. Cover and seal with foil. Bake at 350° for 2½ hours. (Don’t peek!)

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie
ingredients: 1 (15 or 18 oz.) pkg. chocolate chip cookies*
1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Dip 8 cookies in milk, and place in a single layer in crust. Top with 1/3 of whipped topping. Dip 8 more cookies in milk, and place on top; spread with 1/3 of cool whip. Repeat layers with 8 more cookies, milk, and remaining whipped topping. Crumble 2 chocolate chip cookies and sprinkle over pie. Cover and chill 8 hours before serving.
*You can substitute your favorite cookie for the chocolate chip. For instance, Oreo cookies are good with an Oreo crust.

recipes.title: Not Yo’ Mama’s Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) box Instant French Vanilla Pudding
directions: Line bottom of 9-x 13-x 2-inch dish with one bag of cookies. Place bananas on top. In a bowl, blend milk with pudding; mix well with hand-held electric mixer. Beat cream cheese and condensed milk together in another bowl until smooth. Fold in whipped topping and add to pudding mixture, stirring until well blended. Pour mixture over cookies and bananas and cover with re- maining cookies. Refrigerate.
Serves 12

recipes.title: Nut Crescents
ingredients: 4 cups flour ¾ cup sour cream
½ tsp. salt 1 lg. cake yeast ( dairy section)
directions: Take cake yeast & crumble in lukewarm milk.
Cream butter and sugar; add flour, salt, yeast mixture, egg yolks, and sour cream.
Mix dough all together with hands until soft. Leave in bowl and chill overnight.
Next Day: Divide dough into 8 balls, working with one at a time. Leave the rest in the refrigerator until ready to roll out.
Roll each dough ball out, one at a time, on sugar into a circle. Continued...
Spread nut mixture thinly on top. Do not spread all the way to the edges; leave ½-inch edge all around.
Cut into 16 pieces with pizza cutter. Roll from wide end to skinny end. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Nut Filling: 1½ lbs. ground walnuts (measure 6 cups & grind) 3 egg whites ¾ cup honey ½ cup white sugar
Mix together. It will be thick. Add a little tiny bit of milk to thin out.
Fabulous!

directions: Microwave frozen whipped topping and chocolate in medium microwaveable bowl on high for 1 minute. Stir. Microwave an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute or until chocolate is melted and mixture is shiny and smooth.
Makes 1½ cups.
Store leftover glaze in refrigerator. Just before serving, microwave on high 1 – 2 minutes or until glaze is softened.

ingredients: Mix together following ingredients and beat:
1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges and juice
directions: Pour into 9-x 13-inch greased, floured pan. Bake at 350º for 25 – 30 minutes. Cool.
Icing:

You can vary the flavor with different types of Jell-O®, sherbet, and fruit.

recipes.title: Orange Walnut Chicken
directions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine orange juice concentrate, 2 tablespoons oil, soy sauce ,and garlic. Add chicken; seal bag and turn to coat. Refrigerate for 2 – 3 hours. Remove chicken; reserve marinade. In a skillet, cook chicken in remaining oil until juices run clear. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, sauté walnuts in butter until lightly browned; remove and set aside. Set aside ¼ cup green onions for garnish. Add remaining onions to saucepan; sauté until tender. Add reserved marinade and the next eight ingredients. Bring to a rolling boil; boil for 2 minutes. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 5 – 10 minutes or until sauce reaches desired consistency. Serve chicken over rice; top with sauce and reserved walnuts and onions.

recipes.title: Oreo® Cake
ingredients: Melt 1 stick butter in cake pan. Crumble one
package of Oreo® cookies. Mix with butter
and press into bottom of pan.
directions: Mix 2 packages cream cheese, 2 cups confectioners’ sugar, and 1 container whipped topping. Spread over cookies.
Beat 2 small boxes of chocolate instant pudding and 3 cups cold milk until thick. Spread over cream cheese mixture.
Ice with whipped topping and sprinkle with mini chocolate chips or chocolate shavings. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken
directions: In a large skillet, brown chicken on both sides in butter. Combine the teriyaki sauce, water, marmalade and garlic; pour over chicken. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 – 15 minutes or until juices run clear.
Serve with Fruited Rice Pilaf. (See Miscellaneous Section)

recipes.title: Over-the-Top Apple Snack
ingredients: Spoon 2 Tbsp. cream cheese spread on
directions: Top with 1 tsp. brown sugar.
Scoop up dip with 1 sliced Granny Smith apple.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: Flatten chicken to ¼-inch thickness. In a shallow
bowl, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan and basil.
In another bowl, beat the egg. Dip chicken into
egg; then coat with crumb mixture.
directions: In a large skillet, brown chicken in butter and oil over medium heat for 3 – 5 minutes on each side or until juices run clear.

recipes.title: Party Rye Appetizer
ingredients: ¾ cup shredded cheese (half Swiss & half cheddar)
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on party rye bread. Bake for 10 – 15 minutes at 350º

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 regular size Wishbone® Zesty Italian dressing
1 small bottle Salad Supreme (Use ¾ bottle.)
directions: Cook pasta according to directions. Drain. Rinse in cold water. Add remaining ingredients to cooled pasta. Sprinkle Salad Supreme® over salad. Pour Italian dressing over pasta. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Peachy Chicken
ingredients: 1 can (15 ¼ oz.) sliced peaches, undrained
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown chicken in oil and butter; remove and keep warm. Add peaches with juice, brown sugar, orange juice, and soup mix to skillet; stir until combined. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat; return chicken to pan. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 – 20 minutes or until chicken juices run clear. Serve over rice if desired.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients until smooth. Chill.
Meanwhile, put chips and wax in double boiler until melted. Stir until smooth.
Roll peanut butter into walnut sized balls and dip into chocolate mix. You may use a toothpick inserted into the ball or 2 spoons rolling it into the chocolate mixture.
Place on wax paper until chocolate sets. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Note : If peanut butter mixture is too cold, it will not coat properly.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Dessert
ingredients: 1 carton (16 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed,
1 pkg. (3.9 oz.) instant chocolate fudge pudding mix
directions: Crush 16 cookies; toss with the butter. Press onto the bottom of ungreased 9-inch square dish.

In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese, peanut butter, and 1 cup confectioners’ sugar until smooth. Fold in half of the whipped topping. Spread over crust. Sprinkle with peanut butter cups. Crush remaining cookies; sprinkle over the top. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups Dessert
directions: Mix ingredients together and press into lightly buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Melt a 12 oz. package of chocolate chips over hot water. Pour over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. (May need extra crumbs & confectioners’ sugar)

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Stir and bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 8-10 minutes or until mixture forms a soft ball. Keep stirring so that milk does not scorch.
Remove from heat and place in mixing bowl and add 3 heaping serving spoons ( long-handled type) which equals about 2/3 of a 24 oz. jar of Jif® peanut butter. (Jif® makes it creamy.)
Mix until creamy and smooth and place in a butter-greased glass dish. Let cool.

recipes.title: Peanut Cream Pie Supreme
directions: Peanut Butter filling: 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened ½ cup creamy peanut butter 1 cup powdered sugar 1 egg 1½ cups frozen whipped topping, thawed ¼ cup finely chopped, peanuts
Chocolate filling: ½ cup butter, softened ½ cup powdered sugar 1 egg ¾ cup semisweet chocolate chips, melted ¾ tsp. vanilla ½ cup finely chopped peanuts Continued...

In small bowl, beat butter and ½ cup sugar until light and fluffy. Add 1 egg; beat at medium speed 2 – 3 minutes. Blend in melted chocolate, vanilla; mix well. Spread 1 cup chocolate filling evenly into pie crust. Save remaining chocolate for top of pie. Sprinkle with ½ cup peanuts.

In large bowl, combine cream cheese and peanut butter at medium speed until well blended. Add powdered sugar and 1 egg; beat until smooth and creamy. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon peanut butter filling evenly over chocolate filling. Spread remaining chocolate filling in a circle over top of pie to within 2 inches of edge. Sprinkle ¼ cup peanuts over peanut butter filling. Garnish chocolate filling with chocolate curls. Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving. Store in refrigerator.
Absolutely incredible!

recipes.title: Pears /Apple Rings and Cottage Cheese
ingredients: Canned pear halves in own juice
Alternate pear halves and apple rings on lettuce
directions: Place scoop of cottage cheese in center of each.
Top with one cherry on each.
May sprinkle cheddar cheese on before cherry.
Makes a beautiful addition to any meal.

recipes.title: Pecan Cookie Bars
directions: Cream together: 1 cup butter ½ cup sugar 1 egg Press into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 375º for 20 minutes or fewer.
Filling: Heat mixture of 1 cup butter 2/3 cup brown sugar ¼ cup light corn syrup Stir until boiling. Boil gently for 2 minutes. Without stirring, pour over the base.
Sprinkle over filling: 2½ cups chopped nuts
Bake at 375º for 15-20 more minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with 1 cup chocolate chips as soon as removed from oven. Knife edge of pan immediately.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Dip
ingredients: ½ lb. Sandwich salami (or pepperoni), diced
directions: Heat soup (undiluted). Add cream cheese and melt until creamy. Add pepperoni. Simmer until heated through. Cut bread in ½ inch slices. Dip bread into mixture.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Rolls
directions: Cut into 3 pieces while partially frozen. Do not let bread rise.
Place on buttered cookie sheet.

Spread surface of counter or table with oil. Place dough ball (1 of the 3 pieces) on table and spread out with palms of hands. Place 4 rows of small pepperoni slices (about 15 slices) on dough, overlapping pepperoni. Sprinkle with shredded mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350º-400º for 10 minutes.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Percolator Punch
ingredients: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar
directions: In water part of percolator: 3 cups pineapple juice 3 cups water
Perk and enjoy!

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
directions: 1 white cake mix 1 can or bottle cream of coconut 1 can sweetened condensed milk 8 oz. container frozen whipped topping, thawed 6-8 oz. flaked coconut

Mix cake mix according to directions. When cake is done, take out of oven. While still hot, poke holes in cake with straw or wooden spoon handle. Mix cream of coconut and sweet milk together; then pour over cake. After cake cools, spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle with flaked coconut . Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 3 Tbsp. juice. Combine flour, sugar, and juice; mix well. Add to pineapple and cheese. Mix together and spread into greased 1-qt. casserole dish. Combine butter and cracker crumbs. Spread over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350º for 20-30 minutes or until lightly browned. May be served hot or cold. Double recipe for 9-x 13-inch dish.

recipes.title: Pineapple Peach Delight
directions: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in own juice 2 bags frozen peaches 1 box white cake mix Raisins 1 stick butter, melted
Place crushed pineapple in juice in 9-x 13-inch pan. Place 1 bag frozen peaches on top.
Sprinkle box of dry white cake mix over peaches.
Place 2 bag of frozen peaches over that.
Sprinkle with raisins.
Melt 1 stick of butter and drizzle over cake.
Bake at 350° for 55-60 minutes.
Let cool for 5 minutes.
Top with ice cream & sprinkle with pecans.

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix the above ingredients together and pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze. Thaw 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pinto Beans & Cornbread
directions: Cover pinto beans with water and bring to a boil. Drain in a colander and rinse. Put beans in a stock pot and cover with plenty of water. Add the ham bone, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium heat and cook slowly for about 3 hours, adding more water as needed to keep the beans soupy. Serve with raw onions and cornbread.

recipes.title: Pinto Beans & Cornbread
ingredients: Cover 2 lbs. pinto beans with water ; bring to boil. Boil for 5 minutes;; then
drain in colander and rinse in cold water.
Put beans in fresh pot of water; cover with lots of water.
Bring to a full boil ; then turn to medium heat and cook slowly for 3 hours.
Add more water as necessary to keep it “soupy.”
Serve with raw onions and cornbread. (I use Jiffy cornbread mix & add sugar).
directions: Cover 2 lbs. pinto beans with water ; bring to boil. Boil for 5 minutes;; then drain in colander and rinse in cold water. Put beans in fresh pot of water; cover with lots of water. Add ham bone Salt & pepper to taste Bring to a full boil ; then turn to medium heat and cook slowly for 3 hours. Add more water as necessary to keep it “soupy.” Serve with raw onions and cornbread. (I use Jiffy cornbread mix & add sugar).

recipes.title: Pirogues Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. wide noodles, cook as directed
directions: Mix onions and noodles.
French’s® instant mashed potatoes, use 2 pkgs. in box. (Fresh potatoes do not work.)

Put half noodle mixture on bottom of 9-x 13-inch pan. Spread all mashed potatoes on noodles. Add layer of remaining noodles. Grate cheddar or Colby cheese on top. Cover with foil. Bake for ½ hour at 350º.

recipes.title: Pizzelles
directions: Add 3 ¼ cups sugar; mix well. Add 12 eggs, one at a time, heating after each egg. Add flavorings: 1 tsp. anise oil 2 Tbsp. lemon juice 2 Tbsp. vanilla ¼ tsp. cinnamon Add 7 – 8 cups flour, 1 cup at a time.
Bake in pizzelle iron .

recipes.title: Poke Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, eggs, 1 cup water. Blend well. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into greased, floured 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350º for 45 – 50 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add cold water. Poke holes in cake with wooden spoon handle. Pour gelatin over cake. Chill for 3 – 4 hours. Top with Cool Whip® when serving.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Cook to 250º or until a few drops form hard ball when dropped into cold water. Stir in 1 tsp. vanilla and food coloring. Pour over popcorn in thin stream, while hot. Stir and, with buttered hands, form ball.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 6 to 8 chicken breasts, boiled and cut up
2 cans of Campbell’s® Cream of Chicken & Mushroom
directions: Mix the 2 cans of soup, sour cream, and chicken Together, and set aside.
2 sleeves Ritz® crackers, blended into crumbs in a food processor 1/2 jar poppy seeds 1 stick of melted butter
Mix cracker crumbs, poppy seeds, and butter until well blended.
Place the chicken mixture in a slow cooker; cover with crumbs and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours.

Note: To bake in the oven, place half the cracker crumbs on bottom of rectangular pan. Place all of the chicken mixture on top of that. Then put the rest of the cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350º for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Pear Skillet
directions: In a small bowl, combine the pineapple juice, honey, 1 Tbsp. water, lemon juice, cornstarch, and ginger. Stir in pear slices; set aside. In a skillet over medium-high heat, brown pork chops in oil on both sides. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Reduce heat. Pour pear mixture over chops. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 3 – 4 minutes or until meat juices run clear.

recipes.title: Pork Chops Supreme
ingredients: This was one of the first meals I cooked for John!
directions: Heat oven to 350º.
Trim excess fat from 2 lean pork chops ( 1-inch thick).
Place chops in baking pan or dish. Salt well.
Top each chop with a lemon slice (or use lemon juice) and a thin onion slice.
Sprinkle generously with brown sugar.
Pour 1 Tbsp. ketchup over each chop.
Cover and bake 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer, basting occasionally. Tastes like barbequed pork chops.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: Mix together and place in refrigerator until needed.
8 hard boiled eggs, peeled and cut
1 large Vidalia or sweet white onion, chopped
Put all prepared items into a bowl and set aside. This
can be done while potatoes are boiling.
Scrub 3-4 pounds of redskin potatoes (new potatoes).
Place into large pan and boil (with skins) for one hour.
Peel and cut into pieces, while potatoes are hot , into a
large bowl. (Use rubber gloves to handle hot potatoes.)
Add chopped ingredients to the cut potatoes. Sprinkle
with salt and pepper to taste. Add dressing and gently
stir/toss. Refrigerate. Best when served the day it is
