recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: Peel 5 lbs. Idaho potatoes and rinse
directions: Cut into 2-inch cubes Small onion, diced 3 stalks celery, diced Cover with cold water about 1-2 inches above the ingredients. Bring to a boil and boil for about 30 minutes or until potatoes and celery are tender. Turn down to low and add a stick of butter ; let it melt. Add 1 can of Carnation evaporated milk. Stir and simmer for about 30 minutes. Add shredded cheese, bacon bits, and scallions when serving, if desired.

recipes.title: Praline Crackers
ingredients: Separate crackers. Put crackers on a jelly
directions: roll pan. Melt butter. Add sugar and nuts. Boil for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Spread mixture on each cracker. Bake at 300º for 12 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on wax paper. Watch the cooking. Don’t let it get too thick. Use a small spoon or fork to spread mixture on crackers.

recipes.title: Pudding Cake
ingredients: 1 box chocolate or butterscotch pudding, cooked
1 large pkg. chocolate or butterscotch chips
directions: Cook pudding as directed. Mix in dry cake mix. Pour into prepared 9-x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts & chips. Bake at 350º for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Dip
ingredients: ¼ to ½ tsp. ground ginger
directions: Beat cream cheese in a mixing bowl until smooth. Add pumpkin pie mix; beat well. Add sugar, cinnamon and ginger; beat until smooth. Serve with gingersnaps.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: ¾ cup sugar (½cup white & ¼ cup brown)
directions: Mix filling ingredients in order given. Bake in preheated 425º oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350º and continue baking for 45 minutes. Check for doneness by inserting knife. It will come out clean. You can use a deep dish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
ingredients: *Take 1 cup of dry cake mix out and save for topping.
½ cup brown sugar 2 tsp. pumpkin pie spice
directions: Blend together & press into 9 x 13-inch pan:
Filling:
Topping:
Sprinkle over filling.
Bake at 350º for 50 – 55 minutes. Serve with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 4 Tbsp. butter
Re-roll and cool in refrigerator. Keep in refrigerator.
directions: Cream until light and fluffy: 3 eggs
Add: 1 cup white sugar Fold in: 2/3 cup pumpkin 1 tsp. lemon juice Fold in: ¾ cup all-purpose flour 1 tsp. baking powder 2 tsp. pumpkin pie spice
Pour into well greased jelly roll pan lined with wax paper. Bake at 375º for 15 minutes. Turn out on linen towel and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Roll in towel. Let cool.
Unroll and spread with:

recipes.title: Quick & Easy Pork Chop Skillet
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork chops, ¾ inch thick
¼ cup Kraft® Light Balsamic Vinaigrette
1 can (15¼ oz.) pear halves in juice, undrained
directions: Brown chops in oil in nonstick skillet on medium high heat for 3minutes on each side. Remove from skillet; set aside.
Add 2 Tbsp. of the dressing, onions, garlic, and rosemary to skillet. Cook 3 minutes.
Return chops to skillet. Add pears and remaining 2 Tbsp. dressing. Simmer on medium heat 10 minutes or until chops are cooked through. Arrange chops on platter; spoon sauce over chops.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into
directions: Heat dressing in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook and stir 5 – 7 minutes or until cooked through.
Add water, teriyaki sauce, and garlic powder; stir. Bring to boil.
Stir in broccoli and rice; cover. Cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork.

recipes.title: Quick Crescent Taco Pie
ingredients: 1 ¼ lbs. Lean ground beef Shredded lettuce
1 pkg. taco seasoning mix Sliced black olives
½ cup chunky salsa Diced onions
directions: Brown meat in large skillet in 1 Tbsp. olive oil; drain. Add seasoning mix, water and salsa; simmer for 5 minutes. Spread the crescent roll dough in 10-inch pie plate (or deep dish) to form crust, pressing edges together at seams.

Sprinkle 1 cup tortilla chips on crust bottom, reserving remaining ½ cup. Spoon meat mixture on top of chips. Spread sour cream over meat. Cover with cheese slices; sprinkle on remaining ½ cup corn chips.
Bake at 375º for 20 minutes; until crust is golden brown. Serve with lettuce, olives, onions, and tomatoes. Another family favorite!

recipes.title: Racy Red Punch
directions: Mix all together. Stir until dissolved. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Raspberry Sherbet Punch
ingredients: 1 (2 liter bottle) Raspberry Ginger Ale, chilled
directions: Place very slightly softened sherbet in punch bowl. Pour grape juice over sherbet. Pour Raspberry Ginger Ale over the sherbet last. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Raspberry Vinaigrette Dressing
directions: In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the vinaigrette ingredients; shake well. Drizzle over salad; toss to coat.

recipes.title: Refried Bean Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese, sour cream, refried beans, and taco seasoning in large bowl. Pour into lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350 ° until warmed through and cheese is bubbly.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies® Chicken
directions: Roll chicken in oil then roll in Rice Krispies®. Sprinkle generously with pepper, onion salt, and paprika. Bake, covered, at 350º for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove the cover for the last 15 minutes so that it will be crispy.

recipes.title: Rigatoni & Cheese Casserole
directions: Brown sausage. Cook rigatoni and cool. Mix all ingredients, then add meat & pasta. Place in 9-x 13-inch or larger casserole. Put thick sliced tomatoes on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350º

recipes.title: Roast Pork & Apple Dinner in a Pan
ingredients: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.
directions: Add chops; cook on medium-high heat for 4 minutes on each side or until browned.
Add onion, mushrooms, and dressing; cook an additional 3 minutes.
Stir in rice, broth, water, apples, and thyme. Reduce heat to medium; simmer for 10 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus
directions: Arrange asparagus in a single layer in two foil-lined 15-inch x 10-inch x 1-inch baking pans.
Drizzle with oil.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake, uncovered, at 400º for 12 – 15 minutes or until crisp-tender, turning once.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired.
Note: You may also use this with fresh broccoli. I use garlic salt and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Delicious!

recipes.title: Saltine Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 of 12 oz. pkg. semisweet chocolate chips
directions: Line large jelly roll pan with foil. Grease the foil. (Can use Pam)
Lay saltines on pan with sides touching.
Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Cook gently until bubbling and brown looking all over. Pour over saltines and spread with spatula. Bake at 350º for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, melt chocolate chips so they are spreadable. Spread chocolate over hot or warm saltines evenly with spatula. Sprinkle nuts on top, if desired. Cool 1 hour in refrigerator. Pick up foil; peel foil away. Cut from caramel side. Yummy!

recipes.title: Sausage and Rotel Dip
ingredients: 2 cans Rotel® diced tomatoes with green chilies
directions: Brown and crumble sausage. Drain and return to skillet. Add cream cheese and heat on low until melted. Add Rotel® diced tomatoes and stir until blended. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Balls
ingredients: 16 oz. sharp cheddar cheese (4 cups shredded)
½ tsp. garlic powder or 2 tsp. minced garlic
directions: Preheat oven to 375º. Shred cheese and mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Bake 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown.
Note: These can be frozen uncooked and baked later. Thaw for 15 minutes; bake 20 — 25 minutes.
For a firmer texture; add an extra 3 cups of Bisquik® and an extra 2 cups shredded cheese to the ingredients listed above.

recipes.title: Sausage Egg Soufflé
directions: Brown sausage and drain on paper towel. Beat eggs, milk, and other ingredients in bowl. Break bread into small pieces and mix with liquid mixture. Add drained sausage. Pour into greased 9-x 13-inch dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350º for 1 hour or until firm. Serve hot. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sausage or Hamburger Gravy
ingredients: Brown 1 lb. of ground meat (hamburger or sausage)
directions: Sprinkle over browned meat 1/3 cup flour; stir and add 1 can of Carnation® evaporated milk and 1 can of water. Salt and pepper to taste; add crushed red pepper for some “zip.” Serve over biscuits or toast.
Note: May need to add extra milk to get desired consistency for gravy. Cook over medium heat and let simmer until you reach desired consistency.

recipes.title: Sausage or Hamburger Gravy
ingredients: Brown 1 lb. of ground meat (ground beef or
sausage) in 2 Tbsp. of olive oil.
directions: Sprinkle over browned meat 1/3 cup of flour; stir.
Add 1 can of Carnation® evaporated milk mixed with 1 can of water.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add crushed red pepper for some “zip.” (optional)
Note: May need to add extra milk according to the thickness desired for gravy. Cook over medium heat and let simmer for desired consistency.
Serve over biscuits or toast. Also great for breakfast.

recipes.title: Sausage Pecan Morning Casserole
ingredients: 1 ½ cups milk 1 cup packed brown sugar
1 ½ cups half and half ½ cup butter, softened
1 tsp. vanilla extract 2 Tbsp. maple syrup
¼ tsp. ground cinnamon 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans
directions: 1. Prepare a 9-x 13-inch glass baking pan with nonstick spray. Cube raisin bread and put in the baking dish. 2. Brown sausage; drain and cut into bite-sized pieces. Mix with bread in the baking dish. 3. In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs, milk, half and half, vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon until blended. Pour over bread and sausage. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. 4. Heat oven to 350º. Combine brown sugar, butter, syrup, and pecans. Spoon by teaspoonfuls over casserole. Bake uncovered for 35 to 40 minutes, or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Savory Parmesan Bites
ingredients: 2 cans (8 oz. each) refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Mix cream cheese and ¾ cup of the Parmesan cheese with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended.

Separate crescent rolls into 8 rectangles; press per- forations together to seal. Spread 3 Tbsp. of the cream cheese mixture on each rectangle; top with red pepper and parsley. Fold long end of dough up over filling to center; fold up again to enclose remaining filling. Cut each into 4 equally sized squares. Place seam sides down on baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining ¼ cup of the Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Sea Foam Salad
directions: Drain 1 cup pear juice and heat. Use this to dissolve Jell-O®. Do not add cold water. Mash pears and add to gelatin. Add softened cream cheese. Beat with an electric mixer. Fold in whipping cream and cut up cherries. Mix together. Pour mixture into a mold or 9-x 13-inch glass dish and refrigerate until set.
(Makes a nice Christmas salad.)

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 (4 ½ oz. can of tiny shrimp, drained and rinsed
1/3 cup finely chopped green onions , include some
directions: Serve with Toasties crackers (assorted with 3 types)
Double the recipe. People will love it!

recipes.title: Simply Glazed Pork Chop Dinner
directions: Bring broth to boil in medium saucepan on medium-high heat; stir in rice. Cover. Reduce heat to medium low; simmer 3 minutes. Add broccoli; stir. Cover; simmer an additional 2 minutes. Remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes or until broth is completely absorbed. Meanwhile, heat large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium heat. Add chops; cook 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned on both sides and cooked through. Remove from skillet; cover to keep warm. Add dressing, orange juice, and syrup to skillet. Bring to boil on medium-high heat; cook 3 minutes or until sauce is reduced by half. Serve chops and rice drizzled with the sauce; sprinkle with almonds. **Note: May use fat-free, reduced sodium chicken broth and Light Catalina dressing for a more healthy meal.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: After browning and draining the beef, add everything else into a large pot. Bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer for several hours, stirring every once in a while.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
directions: Place in slow cooker in order listed above, beginning with carrots on bottom. Cook on low for 10 – 12 hours or high for 4 – 6 hours.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup (or golden mushroom soup)
**1 16-oz. container sour cream or 8 oz. cream cheese
directions: Place all ingredients in slow cooker (except cream cheese or sour cream); place on high for 5 hours or low for 8 hours. **Add cream cheese or sour cream just before serving until melted. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: *1 can cream of celery soup (*Or use 3 cans cream of chicken soup)
directions: Place chopped & frozen veggies in slow cooker. Place frozen chicken breasts on top of veggies. Add all 3 cans of soup and water over chicken. Season w/spices to taste. Cook on Low for 6-8 hours (6 usually is plenty). When cook cycle is complete, shred the chicken w/2 forks and stir all ingredients. Serve with your favorite biscuits .

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Fruited Chicken
directions: Place onion and chicken in a 5-quart slow cooker. Combine the orange juice, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, orange peel and garlic; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with apricots and cranberries. Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or until chicken juices run clear. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Orange Chicken with Green Onions and Walnuts
directions: Mix broth, teriyaki sauce, garlic, marmalade, ¼ cup green onions and cornstarch in 6-quart slow cooker. Add chicken and turn to coat.
Cover and cook on low 8 – 9 hours or on high for 4 – 5 hours, until chicken is no longer pink. Sprinkle with walnuts and remaining green onions before serving. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast of Beef
ingredients: Peel Idaho potatoes and slice in half lengthwise
directions: Place potatoes on bottom of slow cooker Place a bag of mini carrots or peeled, chunks of carrots on top of and around the potatoes ( I like the real carrots better) Place the English cut roast on top Season to taste (I use black pepper, crushed red pepper, minced garlic or garlic powder, onion powder) I also sometimes rub Gravy Master on the roast to make the broth richer. Slice onions and place on top of roast (or quarter onions and place around roast) Pour 1 can College Inn Beef Broth around roast (to get especially on the veggies) (or use 1 cup boiling water & 1 bouillon cube) Cook on low for about 8 hours or on high for about 4 hours Meat will be fork tender. You can make gravy from the broth by using a baster to remove the broth and then placing it in a saucepan. Make a paste of about 2 heaping Tbsp. of flour and add cold water (about ¼ cup). Whisk together with a wire whisk. Bring broth to a boil and then slowly add the flour mixture until you get a good consistency. You can add a few drops of Gravy Master to flavor and darken if you wish.
A Spencer family favorite!

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1½ pounds boneless beef round steak, cut into 6
1½ cups fresh or frozen whole baby carrots
1 can (14½ oz.) diced tomatoes with basil, garlic
directions: Cook beef in 2 batches in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until browned. Place beef, potatoes, carrots and onion in 3½-quart slow cooker. Mix tomatoes and gravy. Pour over beef and vegetables.
Cover and cook on low for 8 – 10 hours or on high for 4 – 5 hours or until beef is fork tender.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. short ribs or chuck roast *and soup bone
1 lb. beef stew meat cut into bite-sized pieces
1 (14 ½ oz. ) can tomatoes, diced with liquid
6 cups beef broth (I use “Better than Bouillon” (soup
¼ cabbage, diced (¼ head); a little goes a long way)
1 pkg. lima beans (add 2 hours before finished)
directions: Put all ingredients in slow cooker and cook 8 — 10 hours on high or until short ribs are tender and fall off the bones.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Pepper Steak
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, cut into eighths or 1 can (16 oz.) tomatoes
2 large green peppers cut into strips
directions: Cut beef into 3-inch x 1-inch strips; brown in oil in skillet. Transfer to a slow cooker. Combine the next 7 ingredients; pour over beef. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until meat is tender. Add tomatoes and green peppers; cook on low for 1 hour longer. Combine the cold water and cornstarch to make a paste; stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Slush
directions: Stir together until sugar is dissolved.
Add 6 oz. can of frozen orange juice and mix according to directions. Add 2 cans of crushed pineapple Add 8 bananas, sliced Mix and freeze until frosty.
To serve: Set slush out 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.
Good for breakfast or as an addition to any meal.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cut-Out Cookies
directions: 1 cup sweet butter 1 tsp. baking soda 1 ½ cups sugar 1 tsp. baking powder 2 egg yolks 1 cup sour cream 1 tsp. Vanilla 5 cups all-purpose flour

Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks; then add remaining ingredients, except flour. Gradually add flour until well mixed. (Add 3 cups first and use mixer; then add last 2 cups and use large wooden spoon instead of mixer. It is too hard on the mixer.)
Roll dough into 1/8-inch thickness on lightly floured surface. Cut into desired shapes. Place ½-inch apart on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake 15 minutes at 350º. Remove from oven and from cookie sheet before cookie cools! Other- wise they will stick, even if you use Pam spray!
Frosting ½ stick butter 5 Tbsp. Carnation® evaporated milk ½ tsp. vanilla flavoring ½ tsp. orange (or favorite) flavoring Pinch of salt 2-3 cups powdered sugar

Mix all ingredients together except powdered sugar. Add sugar slowly, stirring constantly. Consistency should be like honey. Add more Sugar, or less, depending on consistency. Sprinkle “white sugar crystals” immediately on hot frosting as you frost cookies, if desired.
Absolutely delicious!

recipes.title: South of the Mason Dixon Goulash
ingredients: Brown 1 lb. ground beef with 1 large onion, diced
Add Garlic powder and red crushed pepper to taste
directions: Cook separately 1 box of macaroni
Add to browned meat Add 2 large cans of canned, diced tomatoes Add 3 Tbsp. sugar Let simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Serve with corn bread. Delicious!

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, and melted butter. Add beaten eggs and pecans to syrup mixture, mixing thoroughly. Pour filling into pie crust. Bake at 375º for approximately 35 minutes until golden brown, about 40 – 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Southwestern Chicken
directions: 2 cans (15 oz. each) corn, undrained 1 can (15 oz.) black beans, rinsed and drained 1 jar (16 oz.) chunky salsa 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves 1 cup low-fat shredded Cheddar cheese
Combine corn, beans, and 1/2 cup of salsa in slow cooker.
Top with chicken. Pour remaining salsa over chicken.
Cover and cook on low 7-8 hours.

recipes.title: Southwestern Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite -
½ lb. (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese, cut up
directions: 1 can (10 oz.) RoTel® Diced Tomatoes & Green
1) Cook chicken and seasonings in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat for 5 – 7 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally.
2) Stir in 2 cups water. Bring to boil. Stir in macaroni; cover. Reduce heat to medium. Simmer 15 minutes or until water is almost absorbed.
3) Add Velveeta and tomatoes. Cook until Velveeta is melted, stirring frequently. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Spencer Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: and fluff better than any other.)
Salt to taste and boil until tender. Drain water
directions: Using electric mixer, mash potatoes to get them to a chunky consistency. Add Carnation® Evaporated milk and 1 stick butter. (Depending on the type and amount of potatoes you may have to add a second can of milk or you may add regular milk and more butter.) Mash until potatoes are creamy and fluffy. Place pats of butter on top of potatoes once you have placed them in your serving dish.
Unbelievably delicious!

recipes.title: Spencer Meat Loaf
directions: Brown sugar Green or red bell peppers, chopped Season to taste with: Crushed red pepper (generous) Black pepper Garlic powder or minced garlic

Mix meat and other ingredients together with hands, mix- ing it well. Use your judgment on the amount of ketch- up — it should not be “soupy.” Form into loaf and place in loaf pan. Bake at 350º for 1½ hours. For the last 15 minutes, top with 1 cup ketchup and 3 Tbsp. brown sugar mixed together. Bake uncovered for the last 15 minutes. Note: You will have to learn by trial and error the amount of crackers, eggs, and ketchup to use. Extremely tasty!
You can also divide the meat mixture into muffin cups and the cook time will be reduced!

recipes.title: Spinach and Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 heads of fresh spinach (washed and broken)
Toss together spinach, strawberries, and onion.
directions: Combine all ingredients for the dressing in a blender except for the sesame or poppy seeds. Once ingredients are blended, stir seeds into mixture. Just prior to serving, add dressing to main body of salad and toss.
Refreshing and delicious!

recipes.title: Steak Hoagies
ingredients: 2# thin sirloin steak , cut into bite-sized
6 hoagie buns or sausage rolls (from bakery section)
directions: Place 1 Tbsp. olive oil in skillet and sauté peppers (red & green peppers must be sautéed separately). Do not salt them; sauté over medium heat; will need to cook for about 30 minutes., until soft and blackened on edges.

Sauté onion, sliced, in separate skillet with olive oil. Brown steak in olive oil until brown and tender. Season to taste as you are browning it. Slice buns and line with cheese slices. Place steak in bun. Wrap in aluminum foil and place on cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes at 350 º . Place peppers and onions on top as you choose. Delicious! Liz’s favorite!

recipes.title: Stove Top Easy Turkey Bake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (6 oz.) Stove Top® Stuffing Mix for Turkey
1 bag (14 oz.) frozen broccoli florets, thawed,
1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Add hot water to stuffing mix; stir just until moistened. Set aside.
Mix turkey and broccoli in 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Combine soup, milk, and cheese; pour over turkey mixture. Top with prepared stuffing.
Bake 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Stove Top® Easy Cheesy Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 package Stove Top® Stuffing Mix for Chicken
1½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut
1 bag (14 oz.) frozen broccoli florets, thawed,
1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Preheat oven to 400º. Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package; set aside. Mix chicken and broccoli in 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Stir in soup, milk, and cheese. Top with prepared stuffing. Bake 30 minutes or until cooked through.

recipes.title: Stove Top® One-Dish Chicken Bake with Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pkg. Stove Top® Stuffing Mix for Chicken
1½ lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 can (10¾ oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 pkg. (16 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 400º. Add hot water to stuffing mix; stir just until moistened. Set aside. Place chicken in a 3-quart baking dish. Mix soup, sour cream, cheese, and vegetables; spoon over chicken. Top with prepared stuffing.
Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and has no pink.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Jell-O® Salad
directions: Mix crushed pretzels, sugar, and butter together and press into 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400º for 8 minutes and let cool.

Cream together: cream cheese, 1 cup whipped topping, and powdered sugar. Spread mixture on top of pretzel crust. Dissolve Jell-O® in boiling water. Stir in frozen strawberries. When partially set, spread over cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate. When completely set, top with remaining whipped topping.

recipes.title: Stromboli
ingredients: ¼ lb. thinly sliced Swiss cheese
¼ lb. thinly sliced American cheese
¼ lb. thinly sliced capo cola (cured Italian ham) or
¼ lb. thinly sliced provolone cheese
1 (12 oz.) jar roasted red bell peppers, drained
1 (2.25 oz.) can sliced ripe olives or pepper rings,
directions: Heat oven to 350º. Lightly butter 13-x 9-inch pan or spray with cooking spray. Unroll 1 can of dough into 1 large rectangle; place in buttered pan. Press in bottom and ¾ inch up sides of pan to form crust, firmly pressing perforations to seal.

recipes.title: Stromboli
ingredients: Layer all meats and cheeses in order listed over
dough. In small bowl, beat 2 eggs, garlic powder,
and pepper with wire whisk until well blended.
Pour over meat and cheese layers. Layer roasted
peppers and olives or pepper rings over top.
directions: Unroll second can of dough into 1 large rectangle; press into 13-x 9-inch rectangle, firmly pressing perforations to seal. Place over top of layered ingredients. Pinch edges to seal. Brush beaten egg yolks over dough. Cover with foil.
Bake at 350º for 20 minutes. Remove foil; bake an additional 30 minutes or until deep golden brown. Cool 15 minutes before serving. Cut into squares. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: Pan cook 1 lb. bacon, set aside
directions: Cook 3 chicken breasts in bacon grease Finely chop up or use food processor for the bacon and chicken to make into fine chunks Mix bacon and chicken with 2 blocks cream cheese (not fat free), a handful or two of shredded cheese of your choice Salt and pepper to taste. You can adjust the cheese and meat ratio to your liking Jalapeños Cut stem side of jalapeños off, then cut them long ways in half Remove seeds Fill with stuffing Bake at 375 until heated and soft (about 20 minutes)

recipes.title: Stuffed Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice (not Minute Rice) (add when
you serve or it absorbs liquid)
¼ cup packed brown sugar (can use Splenda/
directions: Brown ground beef, drain. Add all ingredients; bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 – 40 minutes. Or you can place in slow cooker and cook for 4 hours on low.
Note: 2/3 cup dry rice and 1 1/3 cups water = 2 cups of cooked rice.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut tops off peppers & remove seeds. Cook rice. Mix all ingredients together. Add ketchup or tomato sauce to meat mixture. Stuff peppers with meat mixture. Heat tomato soup mixed with milk. Pour diluted soup over peppers. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of meat. Bake covered at 350º for 1½ hours . Top each with a slice of American cheese.
Rice (1 cup) ½ cup water ¼ cup rice

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: 1 lb. extra lean ground beef 1 can (8 oz.) tomato sauce 1 can (15 oz.) Spanish rice 1 large onion, chopped 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. black pepper 4 large bell peppers, tops removed, cleaned of seeds and cored, but not halved.
Combine all ingredients except half can of tomato sauce and bell peppers.
Stuff bell peppers with mixture.
Place peppers in slow cooker. Pour remaining tomato sauce over peppers.
Cover and cook on high for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Success in Life Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix together with mixer. Fold in 1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts and 1 cup coconut. Pour into 11-x 17-inch jelly roll pan, greased. Bake at 350º for 35 – 40 minutes. Test with a toothpick. Make sure the center is done, or it will fall. Cool.
Cream Cheese Icing:
Cream butter & cream cheese. Add vanilla & powdered sugar gradually. If desired, add a dash of nutmeg or cloves to the icing.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Chicken
ingredients: ½ cup flour with salt & pepper
Shake chicken in flour; brown both sides well in
hot oil. Put in 9-x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350º
1¼ cups juice from pineapple (add water if needed)
directions: Mix all ingredients except pineapple, oranges, and cherries. Boil for 2 minutes, stirring. Pour sauce over chicken. Add pineapple, oranges, and cherries. Baste and bake 20 minutes more. Accompany with rice.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Dressing
ingredients: 4 tsp. dried minced onions; add water & leave in
directions: Mix together with spoon:
2 cups sugar 4 tsp. salt 4 tsp. dry mustard
Mix with mixer:
4 cups vegetable oil 1 1/3 cups red wine vinegar
Stir in 4 tsp. celery seeds & the minced onions. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet BBQ Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1 each: red and green pepper, cut into 1½-inch chunks
½ cup Kraft Original Barbecue Sauce
3 Tbsp. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
directions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Using 8 long wooden skewers (2,side-by-side, for each kabob), thread chicken alternately with pineapple and peppers onto skewers to make 4 kabobs.
Mix barbecue sauce and juice concentrate; brush some of the sauce mixture onto kabobs.
Grill 8 to 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, turning and brushing occasionally with the remaining sauce mixture.
Note: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes before using. Wrap ends with foil before grilling to help prevent them from burning.

recipes.title: Sweet Citrus Chicken
ingredients: 1 package (6 oz.) Stove Top® Stuffing Mix for
directions: Preheat oven to 400º. Add hot water to stuffing mix; stir just until moistened. Set aside.
Place chicken in 9-x 13-inch dish. Mix juice, sugar, and butter until well blended; pour over chicken. Top with prepared stuffing.
Bake 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

2 sticks butter, melted 2 tsp. baking powder

Canned yams do not taste the same.) Pour into large, deep dish casserole, greased with butter . Topping: Mix together: 1 cup brown sugar ½ tsp. salt ½ cup flour ½ tsp. baking powder 1 cup pecans Put topping on right before you bake. Dot with ½ stick butter sliced into pats. recipes.title: Sweet Revenge Brownies
directions: Add: 2 cups sugar 4 large eggs
Add: 1 cup flour 1 Tbsp. vanilla
Fold in: 2 cups mini marshmallows 1 cup chocolate chips Chopped nuts, optional
Spread in 9-x 13-inch pan, sprinkle with ½ cup chocolate chips on top. Bake at 300º for 53 – 55 minutes. Do not over bake. Cool. Wrap in foil or keep in container. Decadent!

recipes.title: Sweet ‘N’ Sour Sausage
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 pkg. (8 oz. each) brown-and-serve sausage links
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Set the pineapple and juice aside. In a large saucepan, combine the cornstarch, salt, maple syrup, water, and vinegar, and reserved pineapple juice until smooth. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Add the green pepper; cook 2 minutes longer.
Meanwhile, in a skillet brown sausage over medium heat. Drain. Cut each link into thirds. Add the sausage, cherries, and reserved pineapple to the saucepan; heat through.

recipes.title: Sweet ‘n’ Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into
directions: Place the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag; add taco seasoning and toss to coat. In a skillet, brown chicken in oil. Combine salsa and preserves; stir into skillet. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 2 – 3 minutes or until meat juices run clear. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: S’Mores Dessert Squares
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4-oz. serving size) Jell-O® Chocolate Instant Pudding
2 pkg. (4-oz.) serving size each) Jell-O® White Chocolate
½ square Baker’s Semisweet Baking Chocolate, grated
directions: Preheat oven to 350 º. Finely crush 40 of the wafers; place in medium bowl. Add butter and sugar; mix until well blended. Press firmly onto bottom of 9-x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 8 minutes or until lightly browned; set aside.
Pour 1¼ cups of the milk into large bowl. Add dry chocolate pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended. Spread over crust; top with remaining 24 wafers.

recipes.title: S’Mores Dessert Squares
directions: Pour remaining 2 cups milk into large bowl. Add dry white chocolate pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread over wafer layer in pan. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until set.

Preheat broiler just before serving. Top dessert evenly with marshmallows. Broil 1 minute or until marshmallows are puffed and lightly browned. Sprinkle with chocolate. Serve immediately. Store leftover squares in refrigerator.
To take this to a get-together, wrap tightly in plas- tic wrap and refrigerate as directed. Uncover and top with the marshmallows just before serving, then broil as directed.

recipes.title: Tangerine Tossed Salad
directions: In a skillet, cook and stir the almonds and 2 tablespoons sugar over medium-low heat for 25 – 30 minutes or until sugar is melted and the almonds are toasted. Remove from the heat. Peel and section the tangerines, reserving 1 tablespoon juice.

In a large bowl, combine the lettuce, onions, tangerines, and almonds. In a small bowl, whisk the vinegar, oil, salt, pepper, reserved juice, and remaining sugar. Drizzle over the salad and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Tangy Ham Glaze
directions: Bake ham 15 to 20 minutes for every pound at 325º. The last 45 minutes, baste with glaze several times.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain all beans well.
Add: Salt & pepper to taste 2/3 cup vinegar 2/3 cup sugar ½ cup chopped celery 2/3 cup oil
Place in glass jar or container. Marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Three-Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans and dissolve sugar in vinegar. Add remaining ingredients and let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Toll House Pie
ingredients: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar
**1 cup butter, melted and cooled to room
One 6-oz. pkg. (1 cup) Nestle® Toll House
directions: Preheat oven to 325º. Line pie plate with pastry shell. In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Add flour, sugar and brown sugar. Beat until well blended. Blend in butter. Stir in chocolate morsels and nuts. Pour into pastry. Bake until set, about 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.
**Note: Melt butter and then cool to room temperature (not hot at all) or it will be mushy.

recipes.title: Tortilla Rollups
directions: Mix softened cream cheese with dry Ranch dressing. Spread on tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Roll up and chill. Cut in slices and serve with thick & chunky salsa.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: Place 3 chicken breasts in slow cooker with 1 large can
Rotel tomatoes until cooked. Remove chicken, shred
with fork, and put back in slow cooker.
2 Knorr gel packs of chicken stock (or boxed chicken
Add to slow cooker and heat through.
Add 2 large cans cream of chicken soup and 1 large and
Cut up tortillas into strips with pizza cutter and toast
directions: Place 3 chicken breasts in slow cooker with 1 large can Rotel tomatoes until cooked. Remove chicken, shred with fork, and put back in slow cooker. Mix together: 1 heaping Tbsp. minced garlic 1 Tbsp. chili powder 2 Knorr gel packs of chicken stock (or boxed chicken stock) Add to slow cooker and heat through. Add 2 large cans cream of chicken soup and 1 large and 1 small can Rotel. Add milk to desired consistency. Cut up tortillas into strips with pizza cutter and toast in oven. Garnish with these.

recipes.title: Touchdown Taco Dip
ingredients: ½ cup pitted, ripe olives, chopped
2 Tbsp. Fresh cilantro or parsley, snipped
¼ cup thinly sliced green onions with tops
directions: Preheat oven to 350º. Spread beans over bottom of deep dish baker using a scraper. In a 2-quart bowl combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco season- ing. Press garlic into bowl using a garlic press; mix well. Spread over beans. Shred cheese over top and bake for 15-18 minutes or until hot. Chop olives and snip cilantro. Sprinkle tomato, onions, olives, and cilantro over dip. Garnish with additional sour cream, if desired. Serve with tortilla chips or freshly cut vegetables.

recipes.title: Tropical Chicken Salad
ingredients: ¾ cup salted peanuts or cashew halves
directions: Place chicken and celery in large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and curry powder; add to chicken mixture and mix well. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Before serving, add the pineapple, bananas, oranges, and coconut; toss gently. Serve on salad greens if desired. Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Turkey Bundles
ingredients: 2 tubes (one 8 oz., one 4 oz.) refrigerated crescent rolls
directions: In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese, milk, dill, celery salt, and pepper until smooth. Stir in the turkey, water chestnuts, and onion. Separate crescent roll dough into six rectangles; seal perforations. Spoon 1/3 cup turkey mixture onto the center of each rectangle; bring edges into center and pinch to seal. Place on a baking sheet. Brush with butter; sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 375º for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Turkey Casserol e
directions: Mix soup and sour cream together. Spread into 9-x 13-inch pan. Add layer of cooked & chopped turkey. Top with 1 box stuffing mix, prepared according to package directions.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350º

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
ingredients: 1 box German or Swiss cake mix
directions: Put one half of cake mixture in 9-x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350 º for 6 minutes.
While the cake is baking, mix: 1/3 cup evaporated milk 1 pkg. caramels

Stir until smooth. Remove from heat. Sprinkle, while cake is hot, 12 oz. chocolate chips over cake. Then pour melted caramel over cake. Spread remaining cake mix over cake. Bake for 20 – 25 minutes at 350º

recipes.title: Turtle Pie
directions: Mix together: 1 (12 oz.) container whipped topping, thawed 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 can Eagle Brand® Milk
Divide mixture into pie crusts and freeze.
When ready to serve, top with toasted coconut and pecans and drizzle with caramel sauce.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1½ cups (6 oz.) shredded cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Bake potatoes at 400º for 60 minutes or until soft. Cut a lengthwise slice from top of the potatoes. Scoop out the pulp and place in a small mixing bowl. Mash potatoes and butter. Beat in milk or cream, bacon, onion, chives, salt, pepper, and 1 cup cheese.
Refill potato shells. Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375º for 25 – 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream butter. Add sugar, beat until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add crushed vanilla wafers alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275º for 1½ hours. Let cool before removing it from pan.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix together and serve with raw vegetables cut into bite sized pieces .

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: Raw vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Stir together the sour cream, mayonnaise, dill weed, seasoned salt, and onion flakes. Keep refrigerated. Serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: red & yellow bell peppers, broccoli, cauliflower,
finely shredded cheddar or Mexican cheese
Leave tubes of crescent rolls out to soften a little
before pressing onto cookie sheet. Place crescent
directions: roll dough onto cookie sheet, pressing the edges to- gether to seal them, and pressing it up the sides of the cookie sheet. Bake at 375º for 5 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Baking time will depend upon how thin the crust is. Watch it carefully so that it doesn’t burn. Cool. Mix together cream cheese, mayonnaise, and dry salad dressing. Spread on dough. Top with the chopped veggies and the shredded cheese. Cover and keep refrigerated. When ready to serve, cut into appetizer sized pieces.

recipes.title: Very Vanilla French Toast
ingredients: 1 pkg. (3 oz.) cook-and-serve vanilla pudding mix
directions: In a bowl, whisk the milk, pudding mix, egg and cinnamon for 2 minutes or until well blended. Dip toast in pudding mixture, coating both sides.
Melt butter on a griddle; cook French toast for 2 – 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cubed apples, Granny Smith & Fuji
2 cups canned pineapple tidbits, drained or fresh
directions: Combine apples, pineapple, celery, & mayonnaise. Seedless grapes and maraschino cherries make a nice addition. Toss & coat evenly.
Beat whipping cream until it has stiff peaks. Blend in sugar & vanilla. Fold into fruit mixture & chill.

recipes.title: Warm Chicken Spinach Salad
ingredients: ½ lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts cut into
¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar
directions: On two salad plates, arrange spinach, oranges, mushrooms, and onion; set aside. In a skillet, sauté chicken and walnuts in oil until chicken is no longer pink. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, ginger, orange juice, and vinegar until smooth; stir into the chicken mixture. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Pour over salads and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Warm Fruity Rice Pudding
ingredients: Mix 2 cups milk, drained juice from 1 can
size) Jell-O® Vanilla Flavor Cooked Pudding
& Pie Filling, 1 tsp. ground ginger, and 1 cup
directions: Bring to boil on medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat, add drained fruit, and let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Warm Sweet Onion Spread
ingredients: 1 ½ cups (6 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
directions: In a large bowl, combine the onions, mayonnaise, and cheese. Spoon into an ungreased 9-inch pie plate. Bake, uncovered, at 350º for 25 – 30 minutes. Broil 6 inches from the heat for 2 – 3 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Wasp Nest
directions: 1 box “cook and serve” vanilla pudding (not instant) 2 cups milk 1 box yellow cake mix 1 (11 oz.) bag of butterscotch chips

In a 4-quart saucepan, cook pudding mix and milk according to pudding directions. When pudding begins to thicken or bubble, remove from stove. Then add cake mix to pudding and blend well with whisk. Pour into prepared 9-x 13-inch baking pan. Spread evenly over top of cake batter the entire bag of butterscotch chips.
Bake at 350º for 25-28 minutes. Serve warm or cooled. No frosting needed. Delicious!

recipes.title: Wassail
ingredients: 2 gallons natural apple juice or cider
directions: Heat. Serve hot. Serves 55 cups.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 2 cans (20 oz. each) crushed pineapple in juice,
directions: Mix dry pudding mix, pineapple, marshmallows and pecans in large bowl until well blended. Gently stir in whipped topping; cover.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with additional whipped topping and chopped pecans, if desired.

recipes.title: West Virginia Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 2 ½ cups powdered sugar 1 tsp. soda
Roll out dough with powdered sugar. Powder work
area well with powdered sugar and cut out cookies
Very lightly grease cookie sheet with Crisco® and bake
at 350º for 5 minutes only and move immediately to
wax paper. They will be soft. Cookies will finish
cooking on wax paper. Let cool and ice. Makes 6 dozen.
1½ tsp. butter flavoring 2 lb. Confectioners’ sugar
directions: Mix together & add:
½ cups Crisco® ½ cup water
Note : This icing is great for cupcakes, cakes, or any dessert.

recipes.title: Wheat Thins Nachos
ingredients: Place 1 oz. cut up Velveeta cheese and 2 Tbsp. salsa
directions: Microwave on high for 30 seconds or until cheese is melted, stirring after 15 seconds.
Stir until blended.
Serve with Wheat Thins Crackers for dipping.

recipes.title: Whipped Cream Dressing
